programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. programme.title: SCOTT PETERSON JURORS
programme.desc: The Christmas Eve 2002 disappearance of Laci Peterson and her unborn son, Conner, caught the attention of the nation and started a massive search for the beautiful pregnant wife. But as the case unfolded, the obsession with this story turned into outrage. Ultimately, 12 jurors not only found Scott Peterson guilty of killing his wife and his unborn child, they unanimously voted that he be put to death by lethal injection. For nearly six months the jurors submersed themselves in a case of cold-blooded murder; and now, in a daytime exclusive, they join Dr. Phil to tell their incredible story.

programme.title: WAS MORGAN MURDERED BY A STALKER?
programme.desc: In December 2011, 20-year-old Morgan was found dead in her bedroom of a suspected drug overdose. Authorities later ruled Morgan’s death a suicide, but her parents, Toni and Steve, say that they believe something far more sinister was at play. They claim that Morgan’s former friend and neighbor, Brooke, 18, and Brooke’s ex-boyfriend stalked and tormented Morgan in her final days and eventually killed her. Toni and Steve say they have home surveillance footage showing shadowy figures on their property on several occasions but does it point the finger at anyone in particular? Plus, Toni says she has enough proof to reopen the investigation into Morgan’s death but does she? Then, Brooke joins the show with her father, Jim, and faces off against her accusers. How does she answer to the allegations against her? Tune in and decide for yourself: Was Morgan murdered?

programme.title: A MOTHER MISSING, A STEPFATHER ACCUSED PT.1
programme.desc: Shelbie’s mother, Carie, disappeared on Dec. 2, 2014, and she says she believes her stepfather, Ed, or Ed’s daughter, Lauren, had something to do with it. Ed claims Carie was a drunk who spiraled out of control, using drugs and attempting suicide in the weeks before her disappearance and left their home voluntarily. Dr. Phil delves into what made a 48-year-old mother walk out of the house without car keys, wallet, phone or coat on a cold December night!

programme.title: MISSING MOM: WHAT HAPPENED TO CARIE?
programme.desc: Ed says his missing wife, Carie, has been seen around town multiple times and says he believes she is alive and will return home soon. Carie’s daughter, Shelbie, says most of Ed’s leads have ended in wild goose chases. She says she is tired of Ed and his daughter, Lauren, lying and wants Ed to admit the truth about her mom’s disappearance.

programme.title: RACHEL LEIGH HUTSON STORY
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.desc: Ann Marie and Jackie say their sister, Colleen, is living in a world of make-believe where she constantly plays the victim and lies for money and attention. The siblings say Colleen has disappeared for days at a time and once lived in the woods for two weeks -- and paid a homeless man to try to kill her -- in an attempt to make her family believe she was dead. They also claim Colleen has faked a heart attack, falsely accused a neighbor of rape and most recently told them she’s receiving treatments for cervical cancer -- which they believe is just another lie. Dr. Phil brings the sisters together in search of answers -- and a resolution. How does Colleen explain her erratic behavior? And, is she really suffering from cancer? Plus, Ann Marie and Jackie admit they have enabled Colleen over the years by giving her money and food and paying her bills -- can they learn to put their foot down and help Colleen get her life back on track?

programme.title: “Don’t Give My Daughter Money: She Is Lying About Dying From Cancer”
programme.desc: Mary’s 30-year-old daughter, Lynn, claims to be suffering from numerous medical conditions, including stomach cancer, heart disease, uterine cancer, rheumatoid arthritis and other ailments -- but Mary believes it’s all lies, concocted to gain money and attention. Mary says she has found no evidence of her daughter’s health conditions and was horrified to learn that Lynn had created a crowdfunding website, asking for donations for medical expenses. Lynn insists she’s gravely ill and says it sickens her even more that her mother doesn’t believe her. The mother and daughter face each other for the first time in a year on Dr. Phil’s stage. Dr. Phil reviews Lynn’s medical records -- how does she explain the inconsistencies? And, how can Lynn find a return to health and start living again?

programme.desc: Marilyn says she’s fed up with her son-in-law Adam, whom she calls “irresponsible,” “hot-tempered,” “verbally-abusive,” “entitled,” and a “cheater.” She says she’s tired of what she calls Adam’s disrespectful attitude toward her and her daughter, Miranda, and claims that his reckless spending and inability to take care of his family make him a “poor excuse for a husband.” Adam denies her accusations and says he’s a good dad and provider for his family. What does Miranda say? Can Dr. Phil help heal this fractured family?

programme.title: Our Wanna-Be Male Model Son Is Telling The World We Abused Him. It’s All A Lie!
programme.desc: Stephen, 20, says he hates his parents, wants to file a restraining order against them and wants them out of his life forever. He claims his father, Steve, abused him as a child, while his mother, Christine, stood by and watched. Steve and Christine wholeheartedly deny abusing their son, and say they’re devastated that he posted these lies on the Internet for the world to see. They claim Stephen is the abusive one—and say they’ve had to call the police on him seven times. Can this family stop the mudslinging and find a way to reconcile? Don’t miss this explosive family drama unfold!

programme.title: The Pain of Marriage Remorse: I’m Ready To Leave My Husband Who is 26 Years Older
programme.desc: Brenda says she fell in love with and married her husband, Don – despite their 26-year age gap. But soon after, she claims her “Prince Charming” turned “crazy” and “temperamental.” Is their age difference at the root of their issues? Then, Bev says she’s concerned for her sister, Melanie, who married her much younger man, Devar, after meeting him on a Jamaican vacation. Is Devar in it for love, or for a green card and money? And, Dr. Phil catches up with best-selling author Mitch Albom.

programme.title: “Marrying Millions: He’s 62, She’s 23”
programme.desc: Sixty-two-year-old Bill and his 23-year-old girlfriend, Bri, are one of the couples featured on Lifetime’s television series Marrying Millions. Bill and Bri say not only do they come from two different worlds, but they have a 39-year age gap and are at different stages of their lives – Bri wants a family and children, and Bill has been divorced twice. Bill’s first ex- wife claims Bill has a history of cheating, as she says he cheated on her and has warned Bri it could happen to her. While Bill and Bri have been together for four years, they say they are at a crossroads: what happens when he turns 70 and she is only 31? Also, they say their families don’t see eye-to-eye, which impacts their daily lives. How “healthy” is their relationship? The couple takes Dr. Phil’s “Relationship Health Profile Test” and learns the results. Plus, Dr. Phil speaks with superfans from across the U.S. and has a special announcement for them. One superfan even gets his own “Dr. Phil” tattoo ... live! You wo

programme.desc: A married couple of 51 years share how their entire life savings, totaling over one million dollars, was stolen by a network of sophisticated scammers.

programme.title: Internet Scams and Attacks: How To Protect Yourself
programme.desc: A daughter who says her 87-year-old mother was conned out of thousands of dollars by scammers. Plus, a retired FBI special agent who explains the playbook scam organizations use to target and deceive their victims.

programme.title: Is Gold Right for You?
programme.desc: With so much uncertainty surrounding oil, the economy, inflation, and retirement planning, how do you know if gold is right for you?

programme.title: A MOTHER MISSING, A STEPFATHER ACCUSED PT.1
programme.desc: Shelbie’s mother, Carie, disappeared on Dec. 2, 2014, and she says she believes her stepfather, Ed, or Ed’s daughter, Lauren, had something to do with it. Ed claims Carie was a drunk who spiraled out of control, using drugs and attempting suicide in the weeks before her disappearance and left their home voluntarily. Dr. Phil delves into what made a 48-year-old mother walk out of the house without car keys, wallet, phone or coat on a cold December night!

programme.title: MISSING MOM: WHAT HAPPENED TO CARIE?
programme.desc: Ed says his missing wife, Carie, has been seen around town multiple times and says he believes she is alive and will return home soon. Carie’s daughter, Shelbie, says most of Ed’s leads have ended in wild goose chases. She says she is tired of Ed and his daughter, Lauren, lying and wants Ed to admit the truth about her mom’s disappearance.

programme.title: RACHEL LEIGH HUTSON STORY
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Evolver 62
programme.desc: Globally-renowned historian Mark Lewisohn weaves an array of short, sharp stories into a savvy and surprising reveal of a band that's remained both cutting-edge and massively popular. Drawing from his extraordinary archive, Lewisohn zips through a galaxy of real lives and times, weaving curated artefacts into an entertaining narrative.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: After the murder of his fianc?e and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators. When he meets Lauren after settling in Florida, his cover begins to crack when a neighbor begins asking questions, and opening secrets that are supposed to be buried.

programme.title: 3 Way Poly
programme.desc: A young couple's experiment in intimacy spirals into a nightmare when they invite a seductive stranger into their home. Little do they know, she's a killer on the loose, and their lives hang by a thread

programme.title: Widower Syndrome
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal car accident a year ago, Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone. A race of desperation to find the truth, may also reveal Xavier's own sanity.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Boyz for Life
programme.desc: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters. This action-comedy blends thrilling chases, unexpected romance, and heartwarming moments of unlikely friendship, proving that even in the face of international villainy, laughter and brotherhood can prevail.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert, but is hindered by her reckless mother Shonte. When the opportunity arises for both her and her mother to go, they're surprised to find out they have been invited to meet and greet with her favorite artist. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Lacee: Rise 2 the Top
programme.desc: After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

programme.title: Battered Emotions
programme.desc: Rasheada has accepted that her battle with breast cancer is inevitable but her spiritual fight is still as strong as ever. She continues her upbeat facade for friends and family, but is unsure how long it will be until she can no longer compete with her emotional life's journey. Her sister, Tara, and her best friend, Bunny, struggle with their own issues of inner demons and domestic violence, while trying to support Rasheada through her battle.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister's life but her own.

programme.title: We In This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen's lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family's survival in question.

programme.title: Trouble
programme.desc: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Ceceilius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into a dangerous obsession, fueled by terrifying dreams and a mysterious woman, Robin. With a wedding on the horizon and secrets unraveling, love and betrayal collide, leading to a shocking conclusion where nothing is as it seems.

programme.title: For You I Will
programme.desc: Mikayla is a struggling hopeless romantic. When she meets Jalen, she thinks she's found the one, but he wants a possession over a partner. He demands her loyalty by asking her for a hit list of all of her ex-boyfriends to secure his love. Will she walk away? Or let her desperation consume her and fall into a deadly trap?

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn't sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father's drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Bloodline Secrets
programme.desc: Thirty-three-year-old Keisha is engaged to be married to the man of her dreams, Joseph. Joseph believes he's ready for marriage with the love of his life but his best friend, John, has his doubts about Keisha's faithfulness. When family secrets come out of the shadows, it puts their marriage and lives in jeopardy.

programme.title: Bunny and Clive
programme.desc: Down and out alcoholic reporter Dougie Pierce has been faced with losing his job for not bringing in a reputable report of anything that is worth reading. That is until one day he runs into the city's most notorious duo in crime Lola and Clive aka "Bunny & Clive". When he becomes their hostage, he gets a full on one-on-one interview with this criminal power couple and why they do what they do. He has the most important story of this generation, that is if he makes it out alive to tell it.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.desc: No matter how hard you try to make it out the streets, something always tries to pull you back in.

programme.title: Homeboys
programme.desc: Two young men grew up together with childhood goals. They graduated college and tried to begin their professional lives. When one of the homeboys decided to take matters into his own hands. The situation caused the only family he has to have targets on their backs, and it is only a matter of time before things go left.

programme.title: The Betrayal 3: Neva Ending
programme.desc: Blood is not always thicker than water, and not all friends are as loyal as you think. Four different relationships display love, hurt, and betrayal.

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate's wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister's killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny's life?a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Pump and Gun
programme.desc: Rick Dale, one of Pawn Stars' most popular experts, runs Las Vegas based Rick's Restorations, a family business that finds, restores and upcycles cool objects ranging from Cadillacs to Coke Machines. The before and after reveals of his work are always highlights, in part because of the history nuggets Rick Dale shares about each object, whether it's a barber chair or a gas pump. In this spinoff series, featuring the dynamic characters at Rick's workplace, viewers will watch a variety of objects be bought, bartered and transformed, learning the process of restoration -- how do you duplicate Coke machine red? Where can you find 1920's tires? A storyteller who works with tools instead of a pen, Rick shares when and why objects were invented, who used them and how fixing or transforming them changes their value.

programme.desc: R. Lee Ermey, who played the sergeant in "Full Metal Jacket", applies his gruff sense of humor in this half-hour series that answers viewers' mail about what the armed forces were, and really are, like! Shot on location, Ermey reads the questions on air and then sends them out to military experts in the field for answers and brief demonstrations.

programme.title: Attack of the Semi
programme.desc: Roadways can be a wild place. With violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, 'road raging' is a human behavior that has become widely known. The bad driving phenomenon hasn't helped either-- in fact it's said that 80% of all accidents are caused by 20% of drivers. "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

programme.title: Monkey Business
programme.desc: A&E continues the original real-life series Shipping Wars, which follows independent shippers who have discovered that fortunes can be made by transporting items that traditional carriers won't touch. Each episode of Shipping Wars dives into the cutthroat world of these heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport the unshippable. The competition begins with uShip, the world's largest online auction house for independent truckers. From oversized loads and bulky packages to the truly bizarre, these shippers will haul anything if the price is right. From rookie haulers to seasoned veterans, no shipment is too big for these professionals to handle. Marc, Jarrett, Jennifer, Roy and his beloved cat Muffy are back, along with new cast members Chris and Robbie. One of the industry's most unique shippers, Chris's edge in the business comes from his truck, which runs off of a waste vegetable oil system that he invented himself. While he's on the road, his girlfriend and business partner Robbie books loads and maps out routes while taking care of her son, Carter. Don't let their age fool you, this South Carolina couple juggles parenthood, running a successful business, and taking care of their golden retriever, Gix, who is a permanent passenger on the road.

The competition begins with uShip, the world's largest online auction house for independent truckers. From oversized loads and bulky packages to the truly bizarre, these shippers will haul anything if the price is right. From rookie haulers to seasoned veterans, no shipment is too big for these professionals to handle. Marc, Jarrett, Jennifer, Roy and his beloved cat Muffy are back, along with new cast members Chris and Robbie. One of the industry's most unique shippers, Chris's edge in the business comes from his truck, which runs off of a waste vegetable oil system that he invented himself. While he's on the road, his girlfriend and business partner Robbie books loads and maps out routes while taking care of her son, Carter. Don't let their age fool you, this South Carolina couple juggles parenthood, running a successful business, and taking care of their golden retriever, Gix, who is a permanent passenger on the road.

programme.title: The Big UN-easy
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: Third Week's a Charm
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Couples' Cam: Everybody's Trippin'
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.

programme.title: In A Family Way
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Love and Hate (#101)
programme.desc: Unconventional couples on their way to the altar face staunch criticism from loved ones who refuse to give their blessing and set aside personal prejudices about differences_x000D_ in race, religion, class, or sexuality. With wedding plans well in the works, couples, and their futures are on the line. Which couples love will be enough to outweigh the opposition? Which will crack under the pressure? Whose family and friends will show up? And of those that do, will they voice their disapproval or forever hold their_x000D_ peace?

programme.title: In A Family Way
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: The Monthiversary
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Happily Ever Arranged?
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.desc: Ancient Recipes with Sohla will be taking the food you know & love and tracing it back to its origins. In each episode, professional chef Sohla El-Waylly will detail the surprising history of some of our favorite dishes.

Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Nicole
programme.desc: The immersive new dating series, 5 Guys a Week, centers on a new leading woman each episode, and follows her as she dates 5 men, at the same time, over the course of a week. The twist? They all move into her home.

programme.title: Countdown to Meltdown
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.desc: The series examines each piece of forensic evidence, each witness, each possible lead, and each turn in the road that ultimately leads detectives to their killer. Cold Case Files is a pioneer in the nonfiction forensics genre.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.desc: She used to live in Lagos, Nigeria and run industrial sabotage for a Nigerian conglomerate until she got married and moved to the suburbs. Now she's a bored housewife and her company wants her back for one last job. She accepts against the wishes of her husband who then decides to sabotage the project in an attempt to save their marriage.

programme.title: Strawberry Chinny
programme.desc: After a brutal breakup leaves her homeless, a 28-year-old makeup artist moves in with her childhood best friend, but their platonic bond is tested when his demanding new girlfriend enters the picture, forcing them to confront their true feelings for each other.

programme.title: The Confessor
programme.desc: Rev. Johnson a thirty-five year old priest loses his sister and only remaining family member at the hands of some armed robbers. His efforts to get the police to bring the culprits to book prove abortive, as they made no serious efforts to hunt down the criminals. Disappointed in the way the Nigerian police handled the case, he went away for a while to try to heal and returns a year later to continue his role as a priest. 3 years later, he listens to the confession of an armed robber who narrates a brutal rape and murder of a girl, five years earlier. This brought back old memories and a battle with his conscience, faith and deep seated hate still lies in his heart. After listening to the confession of the armed robber, it becomes clear that he was one of the robber's responsible for his sister's death. He decides to take the law into his own hands by finding all the men responsible for his sister's death and make them pay for their actions. This new development sends chills down the spine of members of the community, as the police and the people begin to wonder if they now have a vigilant or just a murderer.

programme.title: Soul Boy
programme.desc: Nairobi, Kenya. 14 year-old Abila lives with his parents in Kibera, one of the largest slums in East Africa. One morning the teenager discovers his father ill and delirious. Someone has stolen his soul, mumbles the father as he sits huddled in a corner. Abila is shocked and confused but wants to help his father and goes in search of a suitable cure. Supported by his friend Shiku who is the same age as him, he learns that his father has gambled his soul away in the company of a spiritual woman. The teenager doesn’t want to believe it and sets about looking for the witch. When he finally discovers her in the darkest corner of the ghetto, she gives him seven challenging tasks to save his father’s lost soul. Abila embarks on an adventurous journey which leads him right through the microcosm of his home town.

programme.title: Wheel and Deal
programme.desc: Addicted to the desire for this pleasurable life leads a retired Marine Corps to plot a scheme along with a computer genius on how to get rich regardless of those involved. A one million dollars life insurance policy is his initiative and his children;Georgia, Kelvin and Regina are his beneficiaries including his grandchildren (Ben Jr & Benita). To receive the money once he’s dead, he carries on his first plan. He and his felon partner who happens to be a genius in hijacking, infiltrate the health system, pose as the personal to Kels by creating a terminal disease that Kels (this Ex-Marie Corps) suffers from.

programme.title: Gacal
programme.desc: Lonely and heartbroken, Assad is left at home while his charming brother, Nuur, heads out on a long-awaited date with a woman he has been pursuing. Little does Assad know that this day will turn his life upside down. Just as Nuur steps out, a sudden knock on the door startles Assad. Opening it, he is met with a powerful punch to the face. Standing before him is Barkhad, the husband of the woman Nuur is currently on a date with. Barkhad, in a case of mistaken identity, believes Assad is his wife's illicit lover.Fueled by anger and a desire to seek revenge on Nuur, Barkhad decides to take matters into his own hands. He restrains Assad as he waits, knife in hand, for Nuur to return. As the day unfolds, a twist of fate intertwines the lives of Assad, Barkhad, and Nuur. Forced to spend time together, Assad and Barkhad gradually find common ground and an unexpected bond. Sharing their stories and vulnerabilities, they start to question their judgments and perceptions of one another.

programme.title: Daughters of Donald
programme.desc: Chief Donald is living the later years of his life in lonesome luxury and perfect celibacy. But the peace and quiet in his big mansion are shattered when one young lady, and then another, suddenly show up claiming to be his daughters from past relationships he had completely forgotten about. And it will not stop there: everyone is now a suspect as ghosts from Chief Donald’s adventurous past come to haunt him in the form of children, he never knew he had, including some who have been living and working right under his nose, unbeknownst to him. The cultural conflicts and heartbreaking drama resulting from this late discovery of self, and the trauma imposed by DNA tests and struggles for belonging, are only subdued by the hilarious natures of the comic characters who bring the whole story to life. The movie is set in Asaba (Nollywood), Nigeria, featuring actors from Cameroon and Nigeria. Generous use of African Music provided by BGC Melody from Cameroon, Congo DRC, Ghana and Nigeria. Executive Production by Don Julio Bats for BGC Melody Story

programme.title: In My Father's Village
programme.desc: Rhuveneko, 19, rides on a bus and opens a picture book, gazing at old pictures of her father. She goes back to his village to claim her inheritance, but things have changed. Zimbabwe became independent in 1980. A fierce liberation war had brought the long-awaited freedom, but the scars of this war are still felt until today. And the spoils of the war were only going to be shared with a few...

programme.title: Moms at War
programme.desc: Moms at War is about two mothers who live in the same neighborhood, but hate each other. One felt that the other was a village girl who just got into money and is not fit to be in society with them. But both their kids coincidentally attend the same school and there was a competition that was done for the kids, and both were the top of their class. It comes down to one of them winning the competition and the mothers just go crazy, doing all sort of antics. It's a story of friendship, sisterhood, and bonding in spite of everything.

programme.title: Minga et la Cuissinière
programme.desc: Minga is an orphaned girl living with her stepmother Mami Kaba and her stepsister Abena. One day, when she was washing dishes in the river, she accidentally broke a spoon. A furious Mami Kaba then chased her away from the house, asking her to find the only identical spoon hidden by her late mother. A adventurous journey then begins for Minga in the forest.

programme.title: Kileo
programme.desc: Tabu (30s) is a high-performing secondary school English teacher, struggling with alcoholism. Intelligent but reckless, Tabu is cheerful most especially when under the influence, and is a low-spirited nerd when level headed.

programme.title: Watatu
programme.desc: Yusuf is a young university graduate suffering discrimination, lack of opportunity and is raging against injustice. He slowly becomes seduced by extremist thought, which leaves his family powerless to dissuade him. His Uncle Salim, the only father figure in his life, is helpless in the face of his nephew’s ideology. When Salim discovers his new next-door neighbour is actually his long lost childhood friend, Jack, he is delighted. But Jack has become a policeman, a job which in a City increasingly divided by religion and tribe and simmering with violence, places a seemingly unbridgeable gulf between them. Yusuf, Jack and Salim’s lives become fatally and irrevocably entwined as Salim struggles to hold his friendship, family and community together. But Yusuf’s sister has another plan. Knowing that the communities of Mombasa may have the solution, she takes her story to the streets. As the film morphs into a documentary, we see real people in Mombasa assume the roles of Yusuf’s mother, sister and uncle, taking the story into their own hands to determine a new ending and in doing so give voice to the majority Muslim community of coastal Kenya drowned out by extremists on the one side and Government repression on the other. Can the citizens of Mombasa change the tragic outcome of this story?

programme.title: Zahma
programme.desc: Zahma (2023) It tells a story of a widow, Munira raises her despondent teenage son Zuber alone after her husband Changawa disappears mysteriously. When she discovers that a village boy is behind her son's misery, she seeks the help of a former witchcraft practitioner named Zobe. However, chaos ensues when dark secrets reveal Zobe's involvement in Changawa's disappearance.

programme.title: Rishai
programme.desc: Nyakio finds herself consumed by depression and overwhelming guilt following the tragic drowning of her son. Her despair reaches a breaking point, leading her to contemplate taking her own life. With a noose around her neck as she is about to surrender to the darkness, Jay, a tough debt collector working for a local loan shark, storms into her home. Nyakio owes money and he’s come to collect. Fate brings these two disparate souls together, forcing them to share an unexpected weekend. As they reluctantly share this time, Nyakio gradually realizes that Jay carries his own profound emotional wounds, which bear a surprising resemblance to her own. Through their shared experiences and unforeseen misadventures, Nyakio and Jay unwittingly heal each other along the way and get within the grasp of finding hope and a will to live.

programme.title: The Pretty Ones Are The Loneliest
programme.desc: Emem is a 37-year old woman in a rocky marriage not helped by the fact that her teenage son from a previous relationship, Bassey, always gets in trouble, drawing the angst of his stepfather Tamuno. Emem decides to take him to stay with her Widower Father; Dr. Udoh who had retired and has been living in his country home since the death pf his wife. Bassey who has always searched for a place to belong finds it in his Grandfather's home. They form a bond which transcends that of relatives and he has to help his Grandfather who has a love trouble of his own; He is smitten by a nurse he meets on one of his walks but he has never been with another woman aside his late wife who he had been married to for over 53 years. Emem is still dealing with her crumbling marriage and is tempted when a wild painter she interviews for her magazine falls in love with her. Bassey also somehow gets entangled with an emotionally unavailable girl and all three are trying to overcome their loneliness.

programme.title: Coerced Revenge

programme.title: Okomfo Anokye Poma (The Missing Staff)
programme.desc: A man dies and willed all his properties to his son but he can't inherit them unless he goes back to his father's hometown to fight and bring back the Staff of Okomfo Anokye. Okomfo Anokye is a legendary African priest who lived in Ancient times. What is the connection between the Man and OKOMFO ANOKYE and what is the connection between The Past and The Present?

programme.title: Wrong Journey
programme.desc: Some university students go for a trip to a waterfall in a sacred forest for sightseeing and Michael one of them dies. forced to run, they abandon his Corps. as they get to their homes, something is hunting and eliminating them one after the other. until then, Aaron waits and Michael his brother never returned and he has no idea what happened to his twin brother. He decides to go look for him the following day, getting to the waterfall, there lies his brother. Furious and in agony, he screams over his Corps and leaves it the way he met it. immediately as he leaves, a black faceless hooded figure rises from the shrine sterring at him.

Lost, injured and alone, Ivan must discover himself in the jungles of Honduras and face his fears, in order to save his own life...

After earning their high school diplomas, they are admitted to the brand-new and modern Sahel Scientific University, located in the northern part of the country. Unfortunately, on the very first day of classes, Professor Ekoussa, the universityâ€™s rector, is nowhere to be found. Shortly afterward, Dr. Abakarâ€”who happens to be Abdulâ€™s cousinâ€”also mysteriously disappears. The four friends decide to investigate and soon find themselves deep in Waza National Park, which turns out to be a site of unsuspected archaeological wealthâ€¦"

programme.title: Veve
programme.desc: VEVE follows the lives of multiple characters trying to find themselves in a world of political intrigue, revenge, love and longings for success complemented by the background of the thriving yet unregulated veve business. Amos, an ambitious politician, is running for another term as Maua MP whilst facing his opponent Wadu in the extension of his veve empire. His wife Esther discovers the true nature of his affairs and seeks solace in Kenzo, a conflicted young man out to seek vengeance for his father’s death. Sammy, Amos’ right hand man, has to choose between being loyal to his work and being a caring father to his 12-year-old son Kago. Maua´s Veve Farmers want to farm a union to force Amos to pay decent prices for their veve. Clint, a hedonistic wannabe documentary filmmaker meddles to far, blind of the dangers he is putting himself and others into. All are in search of purpose not knowing, that their destinies are entwined in more ways than they imagine.

programme.title: Bendel Girl
programme.desc: In 1985, teen Theresa vanishes into Nigeria's forest after fleeing home, only to reappear 40 years later in 2024. Rescued by Dave, his friend Osas, and Dave's girlfriend Erika, her mysterious return unravels buried secrets and strains relationships.

programme.title: Wamaitha
programme.desc: This is a love story film set in the colonial era during the height of the Mau Mau rebellion, the story seeks to highlight the role played by women in the Mau Mau arms struggle for independence.

programme.title: Oluwoonko (Torn Apart)
programme.desc: In Uganda, the forbidden love between Owinenza, a Munyarwanda girl, and Kasule, a Muganda man, sparks conflict among rival communities when their relationship becomes public. As prejudice and violence rise, their courage challenges generations of division and becomes a powerful symbol of hope and unity.

programme.title: Children of the Wind
programme.desc: SAMIRA, a street child with her siblings has experienced the hard times living without a home and in hunger. She believes going to school can bring her out of her situation but unfortunately the society around her gives no consolation to her and her siblings. As she struggles to help herself and her siblings, her vulnerability explains her fate as a child.

programme.title: Mulasi (My Friends)
programme.desc: “Mulasi” follows a group of female childhood friends Sechelela, Zamoyoni, Ginger and Jamila, who also happen to be jobless yet qualified lawyers. They all decide to bow out and find a way to survive in a demanding society in order to pay their bills. During their journey, they navigate challenges in their relationships, social lives and marriages.

programme.title: Dalitso
programme.desc: Mercy, a girl aged 13 and raped by her step father rejects her pregnancy with the help of her mother through an illegal abortion. The child dumped in a pit latrine survives and finds a home at an orphanage center.

programme.title: Jaja
programme.desc: JAJA is a representation of how people objectify women. sometimes even the women also forget their worth. The problem being within the community which is rigid to change. When a woman speaks up, the community will point fingers at her. Abuse her, calling her all sought of names that will make her appear less of a woman. And yet when a woman decides to keep quiet to avoid criticism, the first assumption is that she is either dumb, stupid or weak. The worst part of it all is when the woman comes from a poor background, she lacks ambition due what people ignore most, fear. She is afraid of believing in herself, she is afraid of achieving more because she may ‘lack a spouse” as the local community dictates, she is afraid that once she succeeds people will not see the effort rather than be blamed for seduction. When in reality most men are not only taking advantage of girls but also working women.The film Jaja brings all these aspects into life. It pushes the motion of women emancipation. We see the protagonist who has been abducted by sex traffickers, her journey throughout the film with the traffickers, and how the authority reacts towards it.We need to free the community from these ideologies that prevent it from progress and make women understand that they dominate their own future, they are phenomenal.

programme.title: Jackie and the Genie
programme.desc: A young girl has a difficult life living on the outskirts of Kampala with problems at home and at school. A chance encounter with a Genie changes her life when he gives her magic powers.Although she agrees that these must only be used for good purposes she quickly forgets and uses them for her own benefits and entertainment ,changing as a person as time goes by. Giving up on her family and friends she learns the hard way what really is important in life.

programme.title: Tour du Faso
programme.desc: It’s Culture Clash in a sporty way! 1987 the Tour du Faso first took place in Burkina Faso. Up until now it is Africa’s biggest cycling race. Within ten stages, cyclists from Africa and Europa are crossing the sandy desert in an existing race. Amid the clash of European perfectionism and African realities we follow European hobby adventurers and African local heroes in their passionate fight for making their dreams come true. Yet, our film does not focus on the question of who will win – instead, it pays particular attention on the value of the protagonists’ experiences. The race has still retained its original and very African character as a “flawed” – but much more sympathetic – copy of the Tour de France, its European model. Some parts of the course are mere sand tracks, the advertising “caravan” consists of a single car and the cyclists are camping in the savanna during the race. TOUR DU FASO takes the audience on a time travel back to pre-commercialised decades. Following the Tour du Faso, we will get to know more about cycling, Africa and the extraordinary fighting spirit of the underdogs. Here it is still the taking part that counts...

programme.title: Our Tomorrow
programme.desc: Our Tomorrow" is a powerful drama set in Kenya, where the rapid acquisition of land by investors has left many without a home. The film follows the journey of Kim (David Ochiel) as he seeks justice for the murder of his father. With the help of his friends Dante (Kennedy Gitagia) and Ryan (Lad Mambili), they take on the powerful and ruthless land developer, Rose (Cynthia Bonareri). As the stakes get higher, the trio must navigate corrupt officials, dangerous thugs, and their own personal demons to uncover the truth and reclaim their land. "Our Tomorrow" will take you on an emotional journey as the characters fight for their rights and for a better future for themselves and their community. Will they succeed or will they become another statistic in the fight for land rights? "Our Tomorrow" is a story of hope, friendship and the determination to build a better future.

programme.title: Hollow
programme.desc: After a devastating miscarriage, Emma and her husband move to a quiet suburban home for a fresh start, but her grief spirals into obsession when she begins hearing a child's voice coming from a locked closet under the stairs. As her sanity and marriage unravel, Emma must confront whether the presence is supernatural or a haunting manifestation of the child she lost.

programme.title: The Silent Intruder
programme.desc: Catherine seeks help from Zaki, a charismatic but troubled sex therapist, to address her marriage's intimacy issues. As she becomes ensnared in his seductive but dangerous world, she soon realizes Zaki's allure masks a dark, compulsive nature. Her attempt to escape not only exposes Zaki's psychopathy but also ignites his obsession, transforming her effort to salvage her marriage into a desperate struggle to survive his increasingly menacing advances. The story encapsulates the peril of mistaking manipulation for affection and the resilience needed to break free from a predator's clutches.

programme.title: Kafa Coh
programme.desc: A story of the fight for justice in the face of power. The fight hijacks a young naive lawyer, Sandrah Atika Alexis who finds herself at the center of a battleground between two political heavyweights.

programme.title: Breaking with Customs
programme.desc: Tyranny chief with his guards storms Nono’s home for her daughter Nsanji whom the chief wants to be his fourth wife as tradition puts it. But Nsanji refuses because she loves Mpaka, her long-time fiancé. When the Chief leaves, Nono beats Nsanji badly until she accepts to marry the Chief. When the inflexible Mpaka gets to know about it, he launches war against the chief although his Father warns him not to defy tradition. Shortly, Mpaka helps Nsanji escape from the palace. Quickly, the Chief launches a deadly hunt for them, and soldiers search the whole village until they capture them one by one. While on a punishment podium, whipped Mpaka swears never to dump Nsanji and Nsanji does the same.

programme.title: Zero
programme.desc: Alone on her bed, Bénédicte, a thirty-year-old woman, listens religiously to the tube ZERO by Papa Wemba - dead, recently on the FEMUA festival scene in Abidjan. In this candle-lit room, her eyes moisten with tears as her thoughts go into her fourteen years spent in the mythical group of the deceased (VIVA LA MUSICA) before focusing on her fears and on its financial situation. A few days later, Bénédicte, who is known as a dancer, goes to a television station where she talks about her experience alongside the one whom the journalist calls "THE SCHOOLS MASTER " and affectionately calls him "PAPA" (DAD) Before announcing his plan to remix his tube ZERO. For completing her perilous project, whose aim is both to pay tribute to her former boss and launch her career as a singer, Bénédicte was accompanied by Moli - a renowned vocal coach and Tosha - a masterpiece of VIVA LA MUSICA orchestra.

programme.title: Dear Bayo
programme.desc: The film is a love story between a youth corper Bayo and a girl he meets Ebipade. Both from humble backgrounds are smitten by each other but to have to overcome difficulties in their personal lives to be together.

programme.title: Fixed
programme.desc: Jay is a campus young man in his last year of study at the university. He was raised by a strict christian family. His expose to the betting world landed him in trouble with his family. One time his friends uses him as a bait to bet and then later snatch him his property when he fail to refund the loan. Luckily with her new found friend Mercy, Jay is saved from the rogue friends and he is able to overcome betting.

programme.title: Thandi
programme.desc: A girl falls in love with a married man she gets pregnant and she gets dumped. She then decides to leave her young baby near a clinic. Sibiya adopts the child, later on Mr. Sibiya falls in love with the biological mother of the child without knowing. After Mr. Sibaya passes away, Connie decides to make the child a prostitute without knowing its the child she dumped years ago.

programme.title: Return of Black Monkey
programme.desc: This story deals with aspects of the European Colonization of the African continent in a very simple but unique way. The story also suggests that, both the Black Man and the White Man worship the same Almighty God but through different mediums.

programme.desc: A teenage girl succumbs to abuse at her new school after her parents’ death but her bravery and confidence turn her into an inspiration before her adversaries.
