programme.title: Rise of the Phoenix
programme.desc: Held captive by her extended family after the demise of her father, Ajabu Sarori Olailepo, 10, must choose between following through with bizarre community ritual of female genital mutilation or try to escape it all. In the burial of her late father, her mother; who is from another community, is chased away and Ajabu coerced into staying back in the village so as to undergo a procedure that will make her a woman. She however witnesses her cousin pass on following the same procedure and Ajabu makes efforts to escape the fatal act who in turn has to back on her curiosity, overactive imagination and determination to find her dispelled mother who has always been the model woman for her and beacon of hope, unaware that the same act is also practiced in her mother’s community. Her course and journey proves an ordeal as well as she faces in extremis experiences that consequently serve to make her a stronger young woman.

programme.title: Matshwenyego
programme.desc: Mr. Mojela finds himself unable to cope with the stress of raising his teenage daughter (Matshwenyego) after the death of his wife. To add salt to the wound, the daughter falls pregnant and the boy responsible for the pregnancy wants nothing to do with her. Mr. Mojela couldn't stand the shame and decided to chase the daughter out of the house. Matshwenyego went to stay at her frend's house where she was welcomed with both hands by the mother. Mojela sorted things with her daughter and she was back at the house. The problem started again when Matshwenyego couldn't stand her father's ways of changing women in the house. She was driven out of the house again when her father confronted her for insulting his girlfriend. Matshwenyego went to stay in the streets and she was nowhere to be found. The boyfriend (Thabo) then made it his business to go look for her and finds her at the spot where they used to meet. Mojela stopped changing women and wanted to stay with his daughter peacefully in the house.

programme.title: A Beautiful Day To Die (Une Bonne Journee Pour Mourir)
programme.desc: After celebrating Sasha's birthday with bottles of beers and whiskies, her three friends, Johnn, Tom, and Sam decide to take her to a nearby town for more celebrations but on their way, their car hits and kills a passerby on a lonesome road. They decide to hide the crime as Johnny, the governor's son argues that it will negatively influence his father's political career. However, on their way to bury the corpse, their car is stopped by a police officer and as the officer discovers the corpse, he is shot dead by Johnny but unfortunately during the clash, the officers shoots at Sam. To cover up this new crime three other people will die.

programme.title: The Itch
programme.desc: Two first time robbers plan to steal from the house of a couple who are having marital issues. One of the robber's, who was raised in broken home, has change of heart and decides to use the situation to help the couple solve their marital issues.

programme.title: The River Goddess
programme.desc: An evil god visits the high priest of a white river goddess [Asuo Subi] To work with him, the goddess warns him not to work with him, but he turns a deaf ears to it and gets banished as a result of this. Out of the white river goddess and the black evil god came out two eggs, one white and one black that produces one good twin, who the river goddess chose as her priest and one evil twin who the black evil god chose as his servant to commit atrocities in the land, the battle line has been drawn, which of these twins will win the battle of the good and evil?

programme.title: Going Bongo
programme.desc: Dr. Burger happily lands a job at the prestigious Beverly Hills medical centre in Los Angeles and his eager to impress his new boss. After attending a Gala arranged by his superiors, he “mistakenly” volunteers to go work in Africa for a month at an under resourced hospital. Leaving his fiancé behind, this American Doctor heads out to Tanzania to follow through with his promise.

programme.title: Scama O'Rama
programme.desc: Two friends, Charles and Nebu battle with survival in the city of Lagos, Nigeria and after searching and struggling to secure any meaningful paying jobs decide to create a fake insurance scheme to defraud unsuspecting victims. Their plan works until a friend reveals their plot to the authorities.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Neema, a successful accountant haunted by her past, seeks her missing sister Tabu with relentless determination, guided by a witch doctor. Her journey is fraught with trials—getting lost in a mystical forest, surviving a bus fire, and encountering Sabri, a teacher, and Farida, a bar owner who alternates between ally and adversary. In a remote village, Neema faces moral dilemmas and violent confrontations, uncovering shocking truths about Tabu’s abusive husband Frank. Their reunion is bittersweet as Tabu refuses to leave Frank. After he brutally attacks Tabu, Neema exacts revenge in a deadly showdown, leaving her broken and bleeding on a bridge. Themes of family loyalty, sacrifice, and violence paint a vivid picture of resilience and despair.

programme.title: Nairobi Half Life
programme.desc: A young, aspiring actor from upcountry Kenya dreams of becoming a success in the big city. In pursuit of this and to the chagrin of his brother and parents, he makes his way to Nairobi: the city of opportunity. He quickly understands why Nairobi is nicknamed Nairobbery as he is robbed of all his money and belongings and left alone in a city where he doesn’t know a soul. Luck, or the lack of it, brings him face to face with two groups of downtown crooks and he forms a friendship with a young small time gang leader who takes him in. Drawn into a new world of theft and violence, he still tries to pursue his dream of becoming an actor. Keeping the two worlds separate proves to be a contest for him as he struggles to survive in this unknown world called Nairobi.

programme.title: Times and Seasons
programme.desc: A young, rich girl falls victim to the ramifications of a dysfunctional family. Her father sends her sick mother packing on her way to do national service. Her choices leave her outside of her comfort zone after ending up with the ghetto's ring leader. Her exposure to the two worlds gave her revelations about her family and her own identity.

programme.title: Prato Frio
programme.desc: Erica, a 19-year-old young woman, lives a seemingly perfect life with her wealthy parents. But her world shatters when armed intruders break into their home and brutally murder her family. As she grieves, the truth comes to light â€” "Frozen Revenge" unfolds as a gripping psychological thriller exploring trauma, betrayal, and vengeance, set against the backdrop of modern-day Mozambique. A powerful story of a young woman who turns pain into a relentless pursuit of revenge.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S02 E07
programme.desc: Amarillo Ames asks Cheyenne to help drive a herd of cattle to Dodge City and take over the mission if he perishes. When Ames dies, Cheyenne must forcefully take on the Laverson brothers, who do not want him in charge of the drive.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E05
programme.desc: Mark takes a job on new neighbor Will Temple's ranch but is taken back by Temple's badly scarred face. When a cavalry officer stops by the McCain Ranch looking for a deserter who committed murder, both Mark and Lucas question who Temple really is.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E06
programme.desc: While repairing a fence on his property, Lucas witnesses a murder. The killer, Corey Hazlett, is the son of a wealthy rancher named Frank Hazlett. When Lucas agrees to testify at Corey's trial, there are threats to harm Mark.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: When a frontier woman's husband is severely wounded from gunshots, she learns a vicious gang is hot on his trail and headed to their ranch. With her estranged past fiancé by her side, the two prepare for a violent showdown that consumes them.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S01 E14
programme.desc: A wealthy rancher hires Cheyenne as a ranch foreman. Shortly after he begins his duties, his friend falls in love with the boss' beautiful daughter. However, the rancher has other plans, as his sights are set on Cheyenne to become his new son-in-law.

programme.title: Maverick - S01 E24
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Big Mike McComb head to a remote Mexican fishing village to help find buried Spanish treasure. But the man who invited them is nowhere to be seen. They find themselves in a dangerous situation with several people, including bandits.

programme.title: Far Haven
programme.desc: In 1887, Hunter Braddock moves back to Far Haven, Arizona to start over with his two young children, but when his father-in-law is brutally attacked he must take on the corrupt forces strangling the town in order to protect what he loves most.

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E19
programme.desc: A beautiful widow hires Bart Maverick to protect her from a mysterious killer, but Bart realizes the poison pen letters and threats are also aimed at him. Intrigue involving money and a dangerous scheme escalate while Bart uncovers the truth.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E03
programme.desc: Cheyenne arrives in Rock Springs. He meets Sam Pridemore, who stops a killer and becomes the town hero. He seems to be everyone's friend. But Cheyenne is suspicious, thinking he is planning to rob the bank of its gold.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E16
programme.desc: At the end of the Civil War, General Sheridan and his staff arrive at the McCain Ranch. Trouble begins when ex-confederate soldier and hired hand Frank Blandon confronts the general, who shot and wounded him in the war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E17
programme.desc: Wes Carney, a famous gunfighter, and his new wife Clair move to North Fork. They open a store and settle down. However, three outlaws come to town to challenge him. Carney refuses and they ransack his store, forcing him to put his gunbelt back on.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: When a former Army officer accidentally kills a woman's young son, he offers to escort the grieving mother through dangerous Indian territory on the way to lay the boy to rest at the family homestead.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S02 E11
programme.desc: A frustrated Army post commander court-martials Cheyenne for cowardice after he abandons a herd of needed Army horses. The commander wants answers and orders Cheyenne to take them to a desolate cavalry base used during enemy strikes.

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E10
programme.desc: Bart Maverick impersonates a wealthy railroad heir, Cornelius Van Rensselear Jr., to gain access into a crucial shareholders' meeting in St. Louis. However, Bart is soon the target of rivals who plan to sabotage the meeting.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E10
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is conned out of $15,000 in Sunny Acres by a crooked town banker, John Bates, who denies taking the money. Bret decides to set up his own con and recruits Bart and other con artists to trick Bates in Denver, using his greed against him.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E07
programme.desc: Assigned as a scout, Cheyenne travels with Lt. Colonel George A. Custer and his regiment into Sioux territory while they search for gold. However, events lead up to the famous Little Bighorn disaster.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E08
programme.desc: A disastrous massacre at Little Bighorn wipes out Colonel Custer's regiment and forces Cheyenne into hiding. But when Major Marcus Reno faces charges of cowardice, Cheyenne re-emerges to testify for him.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E22
programme.desc: Marshal Micah Torrance loses his confidence in his job of authority and begins drinking again after an old enemy from the past terrorizes him. When Lucas learns of the situation, he invites the man to North Fork and convinces Micah to face his fears.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E23
programme.desc: On the way home to North Fork, Lucas, Micah, and Mark take a detour to Micah's hometown. A thriving mining town years ago, it is now a ghost town except for Mr. Newman and his son who still live there. Something is amiss, and a mystery is revealed.

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E20
programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Guatemala City to follow the woman he loves, Ellen Johnson, whom he fears may be linked to a million-dollar jewel theft. After arriving, he meets a clever young street kid named Angelita who becomes his guide to help find Ellen.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E04
programme.desc: Cheyenne finds a young, injured cowboy who is suffering from amnesia. Cheyenne takes him to the doctor and then leaves to investigate a murder and bank robbery. Cheyenne suspects that the young man could be involved.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E18
programme.desc: Abel Goss is doing a portrait of Mark standing on a North Fork street. Suddenly he sees Colonel Whiteside and his sidekick, Jamison. When he recognizes them as the cruel men who tortured him in a Civil War prison camp, problems soon arise.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E19
programme.desc: A young couple traveling to Yuma to get married come across Aaron Pelser's wagon train. Pelser and his group take things too far by forcing them to marry in North Fork, which is not the friendly spirit for a shivaree. Lucas steps in to help.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E12
programme.desc: An Italian man, Emilio Barberini, and his beautiful daughter, Gina, visit the F Troop at Fort Courage. Her beauty attracts the attention of every man, but her hot-headed suitor is pursuing her and swears vengeance on anyone who even glances her way.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E13
programme.desc: A gunman known as Kid Vicious, who looks exactly like Captain Wilton Parmenter, arrives at Fort Courage. Wrangler Jane initially thinks he is the captain but after he terrorizes the F Troop, Parmenter shows his leadership and confronts the intruder.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E07
programme.desc: In his first week on the job as the new constable of Jerome, Arizona, Jim Roberts gets to work arresting the town's troublemakers and teaching his timid deputy how to be a courageous lawman as they track down a stone-cold killer and his gang.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E08
programme.desc: In an odd twist of fate, photographers C.S. and Mollie Fly decide to open a studio next to a dusty corral in Tombstone, Arizona, and they end up taking the last shot of the Old West's most infamous gunbattle, the Shootout at the O.K. Corral.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E01
programme.desc: After frontiersman Daniel Boone forges paths across the Appalachian Mountains and into the newly discovered lands of Kentucky, he founds the settlement of Boonesborough, which quickly becomes one of the most important outposts on colonial America's frontier. But this westward expansion comes at a price. Despite agreements made with the powerful Cherokee nation, conflict between the settlers and natives soon rages like wildfire. For Boone, the strife becomes intensely personal when his daughter and two other young women are abducted by Hanging Maw, a fearsome Cherokee chief. In a desperate chase, Boone pursues Hanging Maw's warriors and their captives through untamed wilderness, with his daughter's life hanging in the balance.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E03
programme.desc: The cowboys are deep in the heart of Texas! In this episode of The Cowboy Way, the guys try to cash in on a cattle bounty roundup: hard cash for each cow they catch. But this money ain't easy thanks to a sprawling 500-acre ranch covered in mesquite brush with razor-sharp thorns. Just when the cowboys think they've found a promising Texas cattle connection, Booger makes a big mistake that could jeopardize their first meeting with a hard-nosed rancher. Back in Alabama, Bubba and Kaley's house guest is beginning to overstay his welcome. As they try to teach Andrew the Thompson house rules, he commits the biggest cowboy sin of all - messing with Bubba's grill! Booger, Jaclyn, and Matthew care for a new-born calf. Misty has a special surprise for Cody. An offer to travel back to Texas for another cattle drive doesn't thrill the cowboys, but they begin to consider the networking potential and how it might make their cattle-trading dreams come true.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E11
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is attacked on a riverboat and set adrift in a dinghy, eventually floating to a dock on a secluded island. The island's residents fear Bret is a spy and take him prisoner, but he soon convinces them otherwise.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E09
programme.desc: Cheyenne faces issues in a small town, including a dry well and anxiety from townspeople, which leads to an uprising. As sheriff, he tries to keep the peace, but the formation of a lynch mob forces him to shoot and kill a prominent citizen's son.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E10
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns a young white man named Mickey, who was kidnapped by the Apaches when he was a child. Problems arise when Mickey's family isn't accepting of his Mexican wife. Mickey rebels against his family, and Cheyenne tries to save his marriage.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E24
programme.desc: While hauling dynamite, Lucas accidentally creates a spark, leading to an explosion. He is blinded and Doc Burrage isn't sure if he will regain his sight. When an enemy from Lucas' past shows up in town, he is in danger, as the man aims to kill him.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E25
programme.desc: When two ex-Confederate officers come to town, trouble ensues for Lucas as he was a lieutenant in the 8th Indiana which defeated the 12th Cavalry 15 years ago. The beaten men were sent to a Union prison camp and now want revenge on Lucas.

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E21
programme.desc: Bart Maverick runs for senator in Silverdale after rescuing Reform Party candidate Ellsworth Greeley from an assassination attempt. Bart's campaign run becomes dangerous when his enemies intend to kill him if he wins, forcing him to throw the race.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E05
programme.desc: On his stop to pick up prisoners for Huntsville, Cheyenne learns of Deputy Gary Thomas' conviction of a crime. He believes that the banker's son, Jud Ainley is behind Thomas' arrest and begins unraveling the truth.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E20
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, 16 year-old Donnel O'Mahoney panics and comes to the McCain Ranch. A posse is on the hunt for the young man, believing he commited the crime. Mark befriends and hides O'Mahoney, who is traveling west from New York.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E21
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart escorts an Indian prisoner back east to stand trial. They arrive in North Fork and Lucas finds out that Buckhart is also an Indian who was educated at Harvard. Angry townspeople try to take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E14
programme.desc: The jinxed cavalryman, Wrongo Starr, comes back to Fort Courage. However, this time he is making the F Troop very nervous with a load of dynamite in his possession. While there, he gets mixed up with a goat after Parmenter assigns him as a guard.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E15
programme.desc: An army captain arrives at Fort Courage and tells Captain Permenter that two troops must undergo a survival test in the wilderness. Parmenter decides to go with Agarn. Realizing they must survive on their own, the two face challenges finding food.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E09
programme.desc: It's not gold that inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming: it's bones. After stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man is caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E10
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E02
programme.desc: Under orders from President Jefferson to explore America's vast unknown frontier, Meriwether Lewis and William Clark lead an expedition up the Missouri River in an attempt to reach the Pacific Ocean...a journey no American has made before, and one that may not even be possible. Leaving Fort Mandan after their first winter on the frontier, the Corps of Discovery enters completely uncharted territory. But as the waterways they travel become too shallow for boats, Lewis and Clark desperately seek the Shoshone tribe and their horses. To communicate with the elusive tribe, they rely on Sacagawea, a 16-year-old Shoshone woman, who accompanies the expedition with her newborn son. Lewis and Clark hope Sacagawea will help them trade for the Shoshone's horses, which will provide the only means of crossing the forbidding Rocky Mountains before winter returns.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E04
programme.desc: First, the cowboys need to track down one of Bubba's most troublesome heifers before she can bust through his fence again. After briefly tending to business and family in Alabama, the guys head back to the Lone Star State to try and expand their network of contacts. Bubba, Cody, and Booger help their new friend Cash with a big Texas cattle drive in the hopes of both leading the herd to greener pastures and finding the big cattle deal they came west for. On the range they forge deeper bonds with their Texas counterparts, swapping cowboy stories around the campfire. But things take a turn for the worse when the herd overheats, and the creek they're all counting on has run dry as a bone. Back home, Jaclyn and Matthew are learning to love life on the ranch. Houseguest Andrew's disgusting habits have Kaley seeing red. And just as Misty gets back in the barrel-racing saddle, she starts to butt heads with her high-strung mare.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E12
programme.desc: Bart Maverick suffers a broken leg after a mountain lion spooks his horse. He recuperates at the secluded Star Trail Ranch owned by Pete Stillman. However, Pete's wife, Kitty, is enamored with Bart and develops a different plan of her own for him.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E11
programme.desc: After his friend passes away, Cheyenne becomes the marshal of Cripple Creek. Disgusted by all the corruption in the small town, he resigns. His successor arrives but may need Cheyenne's help to keep the peace.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E12
programme.desc: Cheyenne travels to Emmetville for his friend's wedding. When he arrives in town, he finds out that his friend is missing. Suspicious arise around the tight-lipped Emmet family and the bride-to-be who doesn't seemed concerned of his whereabouts.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E26
programme.desc: Traveling salesman Speed Sullivan, and his son, Swifty, come to North Fork selling lightning rods. Sullivan makes a call at Vashti Croxton's home where he finds her unconscious. When she blames Sullivan for the assault, Lucas must intervene.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E27
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark travel to a nearby town to sell a bull. While in town, they buy two horses from Mr. Schneider, a man in a hurry. When a posse stops Lucas and Mark on the way home, Lucas learns the horses were stolen. The men want Lucas to hang.

programme.desc: First, the cowboys need to track down one of Bubba's most troublesome heifers before she can bust through his fence again. After briefly tending to business and family in Alabama, the guys head back to the Lone Star State to try and expand their network of contacts. Bubba, Cody, and Booger help their new friend Cash with a big Texas cattle drive in the hopes of both leading the herd to greener pastures and finding the big cattle deal they came west for. On the range they forge deeper bonds with their Texas counterparts, swapping cowboy stories around the campfire. But things take a turn for the worse when the herd overheats, and the creek they're all counting on has run dry as a bone. Back home, Jaclyn and Matthew are learning to love life on the ranch. Houseguest Andrew's disgusting habits have Kaley seeing red. And just as Misty gets back in the barrel-racing saddle, she starts to butt heads with her high-strung mare.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E12
programme.desc: Bart Maverick suffers a broken leg after a mountain lion spooks his horse. He recuperates at the secluded Star Trail Ranch owned by Pete Stillman. However, Pete's wife, Kitty, is enamored with Bart and develops a different plan of her own for him.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E11
programme.desc: After his friend passes away, Cheyenne becomes the marshal of Cripple Creek. Disgusted by all the corruption in the small town, he resigns. His successor arrives but may need Cheyenne's help to keep the peace.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E12
programme.desc: Cheyenne travels to Emmetville for his friend's wedding. When he arrives in town, he finds out that his friend is missing. Suspicious arise around the tight-lipped Emmet family and the bride-to-be who doesn't seemed concerned of his whereabouts.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E26
programme.desc: Traveling salesman Speed Sullivan, and his son, Swifty, come to North Fork selling lightning rods. Sullivan makes a call at Vashti Croxton's home where he finds her unconscious. When she blames Sullivan for the assault, Lucas must intervene.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E27
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark travel to a nearby town to sell a bull. While in town, they buy two horses from Mr. Schneider, a man in a hurry. When a posse stops Lucas and Mark on the way home, Lucas learns the horses were stolen. The men want Lucas to hang.

programme.title: Maverick_S05_E05.mp4 (Segment 1)
programme.desc: No program description

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E22
programme.desc: Bret Maverick wins a massive sheep herd in a poker game from a rancher named Big Coley. However, the sheep are located on territory in the middle of a violent range war. When the cattlemen want his sheep gone, Bret finds a way to fight back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E06
programme.desc: Sioux brave White Crow needs medical help for his sick wife, Little Fawn. Cheyenne and Doc Farnsworth leave to go see her. When White Crow returns with gold as payment to heal her, the locals want to invade Sioux territory, possibly starting a war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E22
programme.desc: Julia Andueza opens a boarding house in North Fork. Lucas remembers her as a dishonest card dealer from the past. Her old boss arrives and tries to bully Julia into turning her business into a gambling house. Lucas realizes she has changed her ways.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E23
programme.desc: Lucas' life is in danger after he agrees to testify in a murder case in another town. The only other witness was killed, and when a gun-toting stranger appears at the McCain Ranch, Lucas now finds himself in grave danger.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E06
programme.desc: Bret Maverick travels to Mexico to find a man wanted for murder, then bring him back to New Orleans. He soon finds the supposed killer, a bartender named Steve Corbett. The two become friends, but only after Bret believes in his innocence.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E11
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E01
programme.desc: Unable to apprehend the train-robbing Smith Brothers, Sheriff Doc Shores calls the Pinkerton Detective Agency for assistance. The agency sends Charles Siringo, an undercover specialist known for his unorthodox methods of capturing criminals.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E03
programme.desc: As a member of Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery, John Colter travels from the Missouri River all the way to the Pacific Ocean, but he decides not to return to the civilized East when the expedition ends. Entranced by the beauty and adventure of the wild frontier, he becomes one of America's first mountain men. As a hunter, trapper and explorer in his own right, he's the first American to see the Grand Tetons and the epic Yellowstone Valley. While his epic explorations make him famous, it's a harrowing ordeal with Blackfeet warriors that makes him a legend. After boldly venturing into territory controlled by the Blackfeet tribe, Colter is captured, stripped naked, and forced to run for his life as warriors give chase in what will come to be known as Colter's Run.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E05
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E13
programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Hollow Rock, Wyoming to attend the 4th of July horse race. In the town, he gets swindled in a card game by a corrupt sheriff who has him beaten, robbed, and thrown in jail. Bret's forced to enter the race to get his money back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E13
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns the body of war hero Cole Prescott to his hometown of White River for a proper burial. However, when Cheyenne arrives, instead of a warm welcome, the townspeople greet him with hate towards the dead man.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E01
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns to his hometown as Sheriff Bodie. He is seeking a murderer in a town filled with corruption. Being home brings back many memories, including an old feud and a man who organized a lynching when he was a child.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E28
programme.desc: Clarence Bibs, a simple-minded man, fancies himself as a gunfighter. While practicing, he falls and his gun fires, killing a famous gunslinger. The man's partner comes to town wanting revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E29
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark go on a hunting trip and soon become witnesses to a robbery and murder. Lucas subdues the two robbers, but is severely wounded in the process. Lucas struggles to get the robbers to justice, but devises a plan just in the nick of time.

programme.desc: With talks of a Civil War brewing, Southern saboteurs know they must keep Northern forces from using the U.S. train system. They devise a daring and dangerous plan to stop and capture a railroad engine, preventing the completion of a railroad line.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger - S01 E10
programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of leaving a man to die, mountain man Jim Bridger is determined not to repeat the mistake. When his trapping party runs out of water while crossing a barren desert, Bridger struggles desperately to keep his companions alive.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E24
programme.desc: Outlaw Sam Morley, an old friend, comes to the McCain Ranch. He asks Lucas to turn in him for the $500 reward and use the money to pay for his girlfriend's medical care. However, a bounty hunter has other ideas.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E25
programme.desc: Tom Birch, an old childhood friend, comes to visit Lucas unexpectedly. Birch promises he is just passing through on his way to Denver. But Lucas soon finds out about a plot to rob the North Fork Bank and must choose between friendship and justice.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E26
programme.desc: Just released from prison, Dan Maury comes to North Fork in search of Marshal Micah Torrance, who helped get him locked up. Torrance carries a shotgun everywhere he goes, but Maury plans to wait him out.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E27
programme.desc: A crooked marshal comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man. He finds a man fitting the futitive's description. He deliberately kills the wrong man to collect the bounty and then blackmails the real outlaw, who wants to keep his past hidden.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E02
programme.desc: As U.S. Marshal Bass Reeves attempts to arrest Belle Starr and her outlaw husband, Belle asks for 24 hours to find someone to care for her young daughter, Pearl. When the Starr family decides to flee instead, the Marshal must track them down.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E03
programme.desc: Teenaged fugitive William Bonney is given a second chance when a kindhearted ranch owner offers him a job. But when his new employer is killed in cold blood, Bonney reverts to his criminal ways, seeking vengeance and transforming into Billy the Kid.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E04
programme.desc: With dreams of fortune and adventure, an 18-year-old Jim Bridger joins William Ashley's expedition to trap beaver along the Missouri River. But a grim ordeal soon forces Bridger to weigh his morals against the harsh reality of survival in the wild. A vicious grizzly bear attack leaves fellow trapper and hunter Hugh Glass on the verge of death and completely dependent upon Bridger's care. As a hostile band of Arikara warriors begins to close in, Bridger must choose between staying with the dying man and risking certain death, or leaving his injured comrade alone in the woods and fleeing to safety. In what becomes a legendary tale of the wild frontier, Bridger wrestles to choose between right and wrong, knowing the harsh retribution that will follow if he makes the wrong choice.

programme.title: Maverick - S01 E05
programme.desc: A dying outlaw named Lefty Dolan asks Bret Maverick to clear a man who was wrongly convicted of bank robbery. Maverick embarks on a year-long quest across the Wyoming and Arizona territories to find Jedd Ferris and clear him of the crime.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E14
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Gentleman Jack Darby team up with an exotic Spanish dancer named Elena Grande to win a flooded mine from its crooked owner, John Wilson. Their scheme involves a staged fight and the fake murder of Darby.

programme.title: Blood on the Arrow
programme.desc: After an escaped outlaw survives an Indian attack in the Arizona Territory, he is determined to help a trading-post family retrieve their kidnapped son from raiding Apache Indians.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E30
programme.desc: Lucas serves as a jury foreman when a Mescalero Apache Indian is found guilty of murder and is hanged. A Mescalero medicine man places a curse on Lucas. At first Lucas brushes it off, then unusual events begin to happen including a ghost stallion.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E31
programme.desc: A brutal snowstorm makes the roads impassable and forces a stagecoach to stop at the McCain Ranch. Lucas gives the passengers shelter, but little does he know a dance hall girl, a drunk, and a famous gunslinger are his guests.

programme.desc: Filmed at the Madison Square Garden in New York, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Linkin Park performs hits including "Numb", "In The End", "Bleed it Out" and many more.

programme.title: Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Live in London 2015
programme.desc: Watch Carrie Underwood performing live at the Apple Music Festival. What a unique concert experience, not only for the fans at the Roundhouse, but also for fans across the globe!

programme.title: Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Live at Irving Plaza
programme.desc: Having already conquered the UK with his chart-topping debut album ‘Long Way Down’, don’t miss Tom Odell’s dazzling live show filmed at Irving Plaza, New York City. Watch the 22-year-old English wunderkind deliver stirring hits like ‘Another Love’ as he brings his heart-wrenching album to life in gorgeous fashion.

programme.title: Live at The Filmore
programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: Live in Milan 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic R.E.M. featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Losing My Religion', 'Drive', 'Man On the Moon' and many more.

programme.title: Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Greatest Hits: Live at Montreux 2011
programme.desc: Masterfully filmed in Montreux in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classics hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.desc: Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Chío paracaidista
programme.desc: Rocío llega al departamento de Paco con sus cosas, pues considera prudente pasar una temporada ahí al no estar Fran y no haber recibido la pensión que le corresponde. Pero se llevará una gran sorpresa cuando vea que el cuarto de su hijo ya está ocupado.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Se busca trabajo
programme.desc: El Borrego tiene que encontrar trabajo bajo la presión de Paco. Conoce su nuevo oficio y a Simone, la hermosa Dj de quien se enamorará perdidamente el papá de Frank.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - After party
programme.desc: Paco lleva una relación intensa con Simone, lo cual le provoca un desmayo por tanta fiesta. Mira si seguirá los consejos del médico, quien le indica que ya no está en edad de tanto relajo.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Aquí se rompió una taza
programme.desc: A los Héroes no se les hace fácil comenzar una nueva vida, mientras que estrellas del mundo grupero graban un disco en su homenaje. A Zacarías, ya convertido en solista, se le suben los humos.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Un nuevo amor
programme.desc: Los integrantes de la banda toman caminos separados detrás de sus sueños. Márgara le confiesa a Natasha que todo fue una farsa. Apolinar se entera y termina con ella, quedándose con Natasha.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Tocando fondo
programme.desc: Zacarías termina su relación con doña Olegaria y comienza a trabajar con el Trácalas. Natasha trata de convencer a Apolinar para dar a conocer la verdad a través de un documental.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - No andaban muertos
programme.desc: Márgara trata de reunir a los Héroes y Zacarías regresa a la banda. Hassan secuestra a Prisca. Los Héroes se presentan ante los medios y hay reacciones encontradas.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Volando bajo
programme.desc: Los famosos enfurecen porque las ventas del disco homenaje se desploman. Zacarías entra en terapia y trata de bajar de peso. Los Héroes no reciben la respuesta que esperaban de los fans y piensan en pedirle a Zacarías que deje la banda.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Adiós, Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda busca a Paco para confesarle algo. Él la espera con ansias, pues cree que le pedirá que se reconcilien, pero eso no está en los planes de la Güera.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - See you later Fran
programme.desc: Fran y el Borrego son asesorados por la bella Jeanine, quien les dará algunas opciones para estudiar en el extranjero. Mira quién de ellos seguirá las instrucciones al pie de la letra y quién será rechazado.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - El que se fue a la Villa
programme.desc: El departamento se siente vacío sin Fran, pero una indiscreta necesidad hará que Borrego consiga asilo temporal en esta casa, siempre y cuando cumpla con las condiciones de Toña y Paco.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Chío paracaidista
programme.desc: Rocío llega al departamento de Paco con sus cosas, pues considera prudente pasar una temporada ahí al no estar Fran y no haber recibido la pensión que le corresponde. Pero se llevará una gran sorpresa cuando vea que el cuarto de su hijo ya está ocupado.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Se busca trabajo
programme.desc: El Borrego tiene que encontrar trabajo bajo la presión de Paco. Conoce su nuevo oficio y a Simone, la hermosa Dj de quien se enamorará perdidamente el papá de Frank.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - After party
programme.desc: Paco lleva una relación intensa con Simone, lo cual le provoca un desmayo por tanta fiesta. Mira si seguirá los consejos del médico, quien le indica que ya no está en edad de tanto relajo.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - El sueño Angélico
programme.desc: María de Todos Los Ángeles tiene un sueño donde sus ángeles de la guarda le anuncian la llegada de su ser amado, pero tendrá que seguir confusas y complicadas señales para que esto suceda.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - El perro de los focos
programme.desc: María decide provocar un encuentro con Albertano para verlo directamente a los ojos y descubrir si es el amor de su vida. La vida de Albertano corre peligro y María se arriesga para salvarlo.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Los chiles de la discordia
programme.desc: María sueña que tiene que ganarse el corazón de Doña Lucha para poder conquistar a Albertano. María prepara unos deliciosos chiles para tratar de quedar bien con Doña Lucha pero esto despierta un sentimiento de competencia.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - San Chambelán
programme.desc: Don Carmelo le organiza una fiesta de XV años a María y Albertano es su amado chambelán.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Sostengo el pi
programme.desc: Doña Lucha organiza un curso de Feng Shui. Doña Lucha y María intentan controlar a todos con el Feng Shui.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Ofertín y los vinagres balsámicos
programme.desc: Albertano se ofrece a ponerse la botarga de Ofertín para conseguir dinero para que el Chino se vaya de excursión y María le paga por una semana completa de trabajo, pero Doña Lucha tira la botarga a la basura.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Bibi maneja
programme.desc: Ludovico le enseña a manejar a Bibi. Federica quiere deshacerse de Maradonio. Bibi choca el carro de Ludovico y la meten en la cárcel.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El funeral del Merengues
programme.desc: Ludovico es obligado a asistir al funreal del Merengues, un viejo amigo de Industrias Camerino, pero se da cuenta que el muerto tiene su reloj y hará lo imposible por recuperarlo.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Federica ardiente
programme.desc: Federica se encuentra con Arsenio, un antiguo novio millonario. Federica de pronto empieza a tener mucho dinero. Ludovico está destrozado por el engaño de Federica.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - La boda de Régulo
programme.desc: Ludovico tiene fama de arruinar los eventos sociales y por ello Régulo hace lo posible por noinvitarlo, pero los chismosos de la oficina lo echan de cabeza.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El loco corte de pelo
programme.desc: Abrumada por sus inseguridades, Federica decide hacerse un arriesgadísimo cambio de look. Sin embargo, antes de hacérselo lo consulta con Ludovico, quien no presta atención y le dice que sí lo haga.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El genio bursátil
programme.desc: Ludovico se mete en problemas en el trabajo cuando trata de ayudar a Don Camerino en asuntos financieros. Tratando de resolver el desorden, Ludovico complica todo aún más, pero Junior lo ayudará a salir del problema.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - La Navidad perfecta
programme.desc: Ludovico sufre un infarto y muere. Santa Ninel le pide cambiar su forma de ser para antes de Navidad si no quiere morir. Ludovico hace todo por cambiar con su familia.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Recuerdos
programme.desc: Ludovico muestra un video en el que recuerda la historia de cómo conoció a Federica y cómo fue creciendo la familia.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Volando bajo
programme.desc: Los famosos enfurecen porque las ventas del disco homenaje se desploman. Zacarías entra en terapia y trata de bajar de peso. Los Héroes no reciben la respuesta que esperaban de los fans y piensan en pedirle a Zacarías que deje la banda.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 7
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano están a punto de ser expulsados del condominio, pero se hacen amigos de sus vecinos en una fiesta y les permiten quedarse.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Se busca un héroe
programme.desc: La banda firma un contrato con altos ejecutivos de Televisa para hacer un reality de talento, Zacarias se entera y amenaza con demandarlos. Prisca denuncia a Hassan, la policía lo encarcela.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor deciden cambiar su apariencia drásticamente para conquistar mujeres, pero deciden volver a su vida normal después de ver que el plan no funciona.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano se emocionan porque participarán en el juego final de su equipo del barrio y les piden ayuda a Natacha y Cuca para entrenar, pues son muy malos jugadores.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Pirámide de arena
programme.desc: Plácido es invitado por su jefe a un negocio piramidal, ¿podrá recuperar su inversión? La familia López encuentra el dinero ahorrado de Gertrudis.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Nace una estrella
programme.desc: Victoria es contratada para salir en una famosa revista. Plácido y Aldolfo ahora tienen una nueva tarea y deberán manejar una banana para los turistas.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Los xpedientes de Gertru
programme.desc: Gertru amanece en lugares extraños mientras duerme, ¿por qué le sucederá esto? Aldolfo y Placido compiten con unos yucatecos por su puesto en el restaurante.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - El cumple de Martina
programme.desc: Martina prepara todo para festejar su cumpleaños. Mientras que, en Acapulco, el jefe de Placido le pide ser parte de su equipo de seguridad.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - La casa de los sustos
programme.desc: Doña Lucha obliga a sus hijos a seguir la tradición familiar de vender huevos de harina en la feria. María cree que Albertano la va a dejar si no le da una prueba de amor y decide llevarlo a la casa de los sustos para pasar el tiempo solos.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - La fonda
programme.desc: La inauguración de la fonda de Carmelito está en riesgo de ser cancelada debido a que María perdió el permiso de salubridad y arruinó la comida que iban a ofrecer, pero cuando todo parece perdido, Doña Lucha llega para salvar el día.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Viva el domingo
programme.desc: Ludovico planea un domingo maravilloso de botanas y fútbol, olvidando que tenía que ir a casa de sus suegros. Descubre cómo Ludovico intenta regresar a casa lo más pronto posible para ver el partido de su equipo favorito.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Encuentro casual
programme.desc: Federica se encuentra con su amiga Columba y las indirectas entre ellas no se hacen esperar. Federica quiere vengarse de que Columba y Bacilio les ganaron en el dominó. Los P. Luche le organizan una fiesta de despedida a Columba y su esposo.

programme.desc: Los vecinos creen que Luis corrió a Pedro de su casa y todos lo tratan mal, Pedro decide irse a vivir con Germán. Don Roque le pide a Frankie que le ayude a escribir las memorias de su vida.

programme.title: Vecinos - Embargo a los pobres ricos
programme.desc: Arturo no puede pagar una deuda con el banco y van a embargarlos, Magda no puede soportar que les quiten sus cosas y hace todo lo posible por evitarlo.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El súper episodio del súper
programme.desc: La familia P. Luche va al supermercado y pelean por un lugar de estacionamiento. Federica se pone celosa de que Ludovico platica con la señorita de la carnicería.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Juego de roles
programme.desc: Federica intenta seducir a Ludovico pero él no se da cuenta y ella llora porque perdieron la llama de la pasión. Ludovico y Federica buscan cómo reavivar su matrimonio y hacen un juego de cambio de personalidad.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Pacosterona
programme.desc: Paco tiene una falla en la intimidad con Simone, así que Betochas le recomienda una uróloga de primera. Mira lo que sucederá cuando vea a la bella doctora y esta le pase el seguimiento a un doctor de su confianza.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Tulum, tenemos un problema
programme.desc: Mientras Simone se va a Riviera Maya, Paco la estoquea en redes sociales. Mira lo que pasará cuando vea que la está pasando muy bien en compañía de algunos galanes.

programme.title: Vecinos - La jaula de las vecinas
programme.desc: Luis consigue una cita por internet y decide comportarse como Pedro para impresionar a la chica. Silvia se molesta con Magda porque le robó su suéter preferido.

programme.title: Vecinos - Un tatuaje para Alejandra
programme.desc: Alejandra decide irse a vivir con Pedro y Luis porque Magda no la deja tatuarse. Lorena y Frankie le piden a Vanesa que cuide a Benito, pero ella sale y lo deja cuidando a su abuelo.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - The show must go on
programme.desc: Zacarías logra entrar a Televisa en el final del reality y después de una votación telefónica se convierte en el cuarto finalista.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 12
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor conocen a dos hermosas mujeres que les hacen creer que están interesadas en ellos, pero solo quieren su dinero.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 13
programme.desc: Vítor acepta tener una cita con una hermosa mujer casada y usa a Albertano para distraer a su amiga, pero el esposo de la mujer aparece y tienen que fingir tener una relación.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - O se callan o se largan
programme.desc: Leopoldito llora demasiado y los vecinos se quejan del ruido, ¿podrán evitar que los desalojen del departamento? Gaby padece de depresión posparto.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - No marches con la marcha
programme.desc: Plácido se encuentra con un excompañero en Acapulco y decide aparentar que es millonario. Después de una marcha, Aldolfo decide revelarse ante La nena.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - En el Mar la vida es más sabrosa
programme.desc: Martina encuentra trabajo y se siente más independiente. Mientras que La Nena y Aldolfo tratarán de convencer a Licha de irse de vacaciones a Acapulco.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Misión Imposible
programme.desc: Carlos consigue trabajo como planeador de bodas en Acapulco. Por su parte, Tere apuesta con una vecina que Gaby puede aprender a tejer, ¿ganará la apuesta?

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Lucha interna parte 1
programme.desc: En pleno día de las madres, Doña Lucha es consignada al reclusorio femenil acusada de la desaparición del El Tilín, por lo que Albertano y sus hermanos buscan la manera de sacarla de la cárcel.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 15
programme.desc: Vitor y Albertano ayudan a Natasha para hacerse pasar por una exitosa millonaria y quedar como una mujer rodeada de lujos ante una ex compañera que la molestaba en la escuela.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - No te vaigas subcomandanta, no te vaigas
programme.desc: Plácido y Carlos son contratados para animar una fiesta, ¿qué aventuras les esperarán? La Nena se pone celosa debido a una visita inesperada.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Se atormenta una vecina
programme.desc: El administrador ha puesto una nueva regla después de cachar a Gaby y a Plutarco 'despidiéndose'.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Que pedí yo

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Sed de triunfo
programme.desc: Doña Lucha aprovecha el corte de agua en la colonia para vender unas cubetas que tenía apartadas. María se pone celosa de la nueva ayudante del equipo de futbol, Citlali, mientras que Albertano se la pasa en la banca por ser mal jugador.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Valle del Nabo
programme.desc: El novio de Bibi, Manuel, la invita a Valle del Nabo a pasar el fin de semana. La familia de Bibi los alcanza en casa de Manuel. Manuel termina con Bibi por ser amargada y rara.

programme.desc: La familia P. Luche festeja el día de las madres, Federica no recibe ni un regalo. Maradonio sí le compra un regalo a Excelsa, esto hace que Federica se enoje mucho y espera una gran sorpresa de recompensa.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Y el ganador es...
programme.desc: Mientras festejan el final del reality, el autobús deja a los héroes tirados en la carretera. Pasan la noche con una familia que lleva 40 años de muertos.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 16
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano deciden comprar una fábrica para producir accesorios corrientes y vulgares para decorar automóviles, pero por más que intentan colocar sus productos nadie quiere distribuirlos y tienen que venderlos en la calle.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 17
programme.desc: Asustados por la inseguridad y temiendo perder su fortuna, Vítor y Albertano deciden comprar un rancho e irse a vivir al campo, pero los peligros de la ciudad no son nada comparados con el terror de enfrentarse al temible Charro sin Cabeza.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Socio repartidor distinguido
programme.desc: Justito quiere pasar el examen de niños genio, pero cuidar a su hermanito podría arruinarlo. Plácido está decidido a regresar a México.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Una nana explotada
programme.desc: Un descuido provoca que la cocina explote. Mientras que, en Acapulco, Plácido está desesperado por regresar a ver a su familia.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Departamento madre
programme.desc: La familia López buscará una forma de rentar el departamento que está vacío, ¿la vocera del colegio de genios aprovechará la oportunidad?

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Fue en un cabaret donde me encontré chafeando
programme.desc: Olegario otorga la gerencia de su hotel a uno de sus amigos, por lo que Placido regresará a su puesto habitual.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Patadas de ahogada
programme.desc: María trata de recuperar el amor de Albertano y hace el ridículo durante su fiesta de cumpleaños. Doña Lucha le da una lección a Rosa Aurora para hacer que se aleje de una mala amistad.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Angeloterapeuta
programme.desc: Albertano le pide a María que se den un tiempo y ella decide recuperar a sus ángeles para que la ayuden a superar su rompimiento. Doña Lucha cree que ya es tiempo de que platique con el Chino sobre temas de adultos.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Reparaciones
programme.desc: Federica contrata un carpintero guapísimo para arreglar una puerta. Ludovico se pone muy celoso de Sebastián el carpintero y quiere demostrar que él puede hacer las cosas mejor. Ludovico hace un desastre en su casa.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El cumpleaños atrasado de Ludovico
programme.desc: Federica tiene un plan para hacer que Ludovico la lleve a comer a un nuevo restaurante. La familia P. Luche conoce a Eduardo Santamarina. Todo sale muy mal en la cena.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Tattoo por amor
programme.desc: Paco y Brayan están deprimidos por la ruptura de sus relaciones, pero con la ayuda del Borrego, intentarán recuperarlas. Ve, si con sus consejos lograrán el perdón de sus exparejas o habrá sido peor el remedio que el problema.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Tatuados sin gloria
programme.desc: Paco quiere borrarse el tatuaje de Simone y encuentra un grupo que lo podrá ayudar, ahí mismo conoce a Mila a quien intentará ligarse, pero debe confesarse. ¿Logrará Mila convencer a Paco de dejarse su tattoo o se lo quitará para siempre?

programme.title: Vecinos - Sin ton ni Silvia
programme.desc: Silvia tiene dos pretendientes y su amiga le aconseja que salga con ambos, ella le pide ayuda a Germán para que no la descubran. Vanesa quiere llevar a su abuelo al doctor pero él no quiere ir.

programme.title: Vecinos - Truco o trato
programme.desc: Magda está decidida a vender su coche y les dice a los vecinos que comprará uno nuevo.

programme.desc: Giuliano le pide a Justo que le dé 10 millones de dólares a cambio de no hacerle daño a Wendy. Elvira le pide a María que ayude a que su padre acepte que tiene una enfermedad.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 142
programme.desc: Santos comienza a alucinar debido a su encierro en la cárcel. Curtis y Derecho unen sus vidas en sagrado matrimonio. María no quita el dedo del renglón y vive con la esperanza de poder volver a Santos.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 143
programme.desc: María convence a Susanito de no dejar de luchar por el amor de Irasema. Concho teme morir en el quirófano y no poder volver a ver su familia.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 147
programme.desc: Artemio se molesta al saber que Bárbara lo ha traicionado. Bárbara intenta convencer a Artemio de que libere a Liliana. Bárbara lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Damián. Eduardo teme que Venus intente matar a Camilo.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 31
programme.desc: Fermín, para calmar a Lucio Malaver, le cuenta el verdadero origen de Esmeralda. Fátima trata de burlarse de Esmeralda al regalarle unos vestidos, pero José Armando muestra desaprobación. Dominga le cuenta a Esmeralda la verdad sobre sus padres.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 20
programme.desc: Rita discute de nuevo con Santiago por Camila. Alberto se nota atraído por Lisabeta y le ofrece su ayuda. Aparecen piratas en el pueblo, Ricardo y Mario se dan cuenta que son 'la Paisana' y Juancho. Justo le dice a Santiago que le buscará marido a Camila.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 61
programme.desc: Ana Leticia se lleva una fuerte impresión al ver a Marcelo con vida. Santiago le asegura a la falsa Ana Laura que alguien intentó asesinarlo años atrás y que está enamorado de otra mujer. Antes de la operación de Iñaki, Julieta se entera que Daniel murió.

programme.title: Fuego en la Sangre Capítulo 105
programme.desc: Sarita y Jimena le dicen a Eva que aunque no pueden perdonarla, dejarán que se acerque a Sofía. Sofía sufre por no poder encontrar a su hija. Leonora se encuentra en el monte con su campaña de vacunación.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 51
programme.desc: Esteban queda en coma después del accidente automovilístico. Estefany logra que Esteban despierte, él le pide que se vaya. Alberto le revela a Isabel que él sabe que ella es la culpable del accidente de Esteban.

programme.desc: María convence a Susanito de no dejar de luchar por el amor de Irasema. Concho teme morir en el quirófano y no poder volver a ver su familia.

programme.desc: Don Jorge le pide a su hija Úrsula que le ayude a distraer a Don Ricardo. Santiago habla con Ascanio para ofrecerle que se case con Inés y también le ofrece empleo. Don Jorge le propone a Justo que case a Inés con don Gonzalo.
