programme.desc: Una joven se escapa de su casa después de que su papá intenta abusar de ella, la chica va a casa de uno de sus amigos y le cuenta lo que pasó. El joven y sus amigos abusan de ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que la hace'
programme.desc: Una mujer secuestra a la nieta de un hombre mayor y le dice que debe hacer todo lo que ella le diga para pagar el dinero que le debe su abuelo. El sobrino de la mujer descubre que su tía es una secuestradora y la denuncia.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Las apariencias engañan'
programme.desc: Un señor es contratado para ser chofer de un camión de eventos sociales, pero su jefe lo usa para transportar a jóvenes que vende como trata de blancas y su hija resulta ser una de ellas.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'De tal palo, tal astilla'
programme.desc: Un padre de familia golpea a su esposa e hija, la joven planea huir con su novio, pero el hermano de la chica regresa, él denuncia a su padre para que lo detengan y ella no se va.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Haz el bien'
programme.desc: Un indigente es apedreado por unos niños, un señor lo ayuda, lo lleva al hospital y le avisa a su familia para que vayan a buscarlo. El indigente se recupera y le regala su carro al señor para agradecerle.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que con lobos se junta'
programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes roban en el 'Café El Dicho' y el más pequeño se encuentra con un famoso luchador, quien le cuenta que tiene una historia muy similar, y le platica sobre la muerte de su mamá.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Las mentiras tienen las piernas cortas Parte 2'
programme.desc: Poncho, el mesero del café 'El Dicho', encuentra una foto de su mamá con un hombre y él cree que es su papá. Poncho comprende las razones por las que su mamá nunca le dijo la verdad y se reconcilia con ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Ten cuidado con lo que deseas'
programme.desc: Una chica trata de escapar de su casa para salir con su novio, pero su hermana grita y les avisa a sus padres para que lo eviten. El padre hace hasta lo imposible para que su hija deje de verse con su novio.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que siembra vientos cosecha tempestades'
programme.desc: Una joven se escapa de su casa después de que su papá intenta abusar de ella, la chica va a casa de uno de sus amigos y le cuenta lo que pasó. El joven y sus amigos abusan de ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No por miedo a fallar'
programme.desc: Una señora le pide a su hija que se vaya de la casa porque su patrona cree que ella le robó dinero. Cuando la chica va a su casa un hombre la secuestra, la lleva a una casa y trata de prostituirla.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Diablo te hiciste'
programme.desc: Miriam, es una adolescente que por falta de atención de sus padres, cae en una broma pesada por internet. El padre de Miriam es aficionado a ver páginas en internet de adolescentes y encuentra las fotos de su hija en una página prohibida.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Al que no habla'
programme.desc: Una chica va caminando con un amigo de la escuela de regreso a su casa, cuando el novio de su mamá los encuentra en la calle y amenaza al chico para que se aleje de ella. Cuando llegan al departamento, el novio de la mamá intenta manosear a la chica.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que quiere la flor'
programme.desc: Una joven embarazada es abandonada por el padre de su hijo, su mejor amigo la consuela. Los amigos del ex novio lo golpean. La joven le confiesa que está embarazada y él le dice que la apoya para que se deshaga del niño.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - ‘El que tiene más saliva’
programme.desc: Una chica que es integrante de una banda se pelea con el vocalista porque sabe que es una mala persona, pero una de sus amigas lo defiende y comienza a tratarla mal hasta que ella decide dejar la banda.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Agua que no has de beber'
programme.desc: Un joven ve cambiar su vida cuando comienza un romance apresurado con una joven. Ella resulta embarazada y esto altera todos sus planes, aunque trata de apoyarla, sus vidas toman caminos diferentes.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'La familia que crece unida'
programme.desc: Una mujer le guarda rencor a su hermana por errores del pasado, pero debido a la enfermedad de su mamá las mujeres encuentran fuerza juntas para superar los problemas.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El Lobo Pierde el Pelo'
programme.desc: Isa conoce a Mario, un chico que la hace comprender muchas cosas y seguir firme en sus decisiones y valores. Una tarde su novio y su madre se presentan en la cafetería para pedirle que regrese a Guadalajara. Isabel decide terminar con Ernesto.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Lo que no fue en tu año'
programme.desc: Un hombre recién casado comienza a desconfiar de su esposa, pues descubre que no le dijo su verdadero nombre. El hombre le pide ayuda a un amigo para investigar a su mujer, ella finalmente le cuenta la verdad.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Fue sin querer queriendo'
programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el “Poncholín colorado” y el “Poncho del ocho” haciendo homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El amor que se hace nudo'
programme.desc: Un joven festeja su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y termina en casa de una chava que conoció en el bar. El joven les cuenta a sus amigos que la chava lo acosa y agrede a su novia. El joven le confiesa a su novia lo que pasó y ella termina con él.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Donde hubo fuego'
programme.desc: Rogelio, un hombre comprometido con su novia, se reencuentra con Susana, su primer amor. Después de dudar y estar en una incertidumbre, se ve con Nadia y platican sobre el añorado primer amor que vivieron, dejando en claro sus sentimientos.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que nace pa’ maceta'
programme.desc: Un joven que sufre de sordera es maltratado por sus compañeros de la escuela y su familia. El chico vive con sus tíos, su tía lo odia y le exige a su esposo correrlo de la casa. La maestra del chico y una niña tratan de ayudarlo.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El valiente vive, hasta que el cobarde quiere'
programme.desc: Un joven es abusivo con sus compañeros de la escuela golpeándolos y quitándoles todo su dinero. El joven, su madre y hermano son maltratados por su padre lo que provoca que el chico sea tan agresivo.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - ‘Ojos que no ven’
programme.desc: Lucía es una chica que descubre la infidelidad de su novio. Lucía tiene una infección en los ojos y su madre compra un medicamento económico que le provoca ceguera. La joven culpa a su mamá de su desgracia, pero pronto su vida cambiará.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No todo lo que brilla es oro'
programme.desc: Una joven cantante que vive noches de fiesta todos los días conoce a un hombre, se enamora y le pide que sea su nuevo representante. Él la mete al mundo de las drogas arruinando su vida y la de su familia.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Contigo la milpa es rancho'
programme.desc: Un joven regresa a su pueblo y se entera que su padre ha muerto. El chico amenaza a un hombre cuando descubre que quiere abusar de su novia. El hombre mata a la madre del chico para quedarse con sus tierras.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El momento más oscuro'
programme.desc: Una jovencita es golpeada por su padre, y para proteger a su madre, no se queja de nada. La mamá de la niña se la pasa tomando pastillas para dormir y descuida a su hija. La maestra se da cuenta de que es maltratada por sus padres.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Aunque la jaula sea de oro'
programme.desc: Karina se casa con Luis perdidamente enamorada, sin saber que es un celópata, con el paso del tiempo se entera que, Sofía, su ex mujer, se suicidó por culpa de la enfermedad de su marido y le pide a la servidumbre que la ayude a escapar.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'No tiene la culpa el indio'
programme.desc: Un señor sufre un accidente en una construcción. Un joven que trabaja en la construcción queda impactado con el accidente de uno de sus compañeros. La hermana del joven sufre de bullying por ser indígena.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que esté libre de culpa'
programme.desc: Una joven se embaraza del novio de su mejor amiga, la chica oculta la identidad del padre de su hijo. Durante su embarazo la chica les dice a sus amigas que no quiere a su hijo y desea que el bebé nazca sin vida.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'Nada mejor en la vida'
programme.desc: Liz se embaraza de Saúl, su novio, pero no quiere hacerse responsable. Liz tiene un padre autoritario al cual no le tiene confianza pero sin querer, se entera que su hija está embarazada. Él les obliga a casarse pero todo es un fracaso.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Caras vemos'
programme.desc: Una joven que es muy celosa golpea a una chica y le prohíbe hablarle a su novio. Un día la chica y su novio terminan y él le confiesa que está enamorado de otra chica. La joven le pide al chico que vaya a su casa y lo secuestra.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho - 'Dios aprieta pero no ahorca'
programme.desc: Una joven vive con su abuela, pero la señora la trata muy mal porque ella es hija de la sirvienta. El hijo de la señora pierde su casa en un juego y le pide a su madre que deje que él y su familia vivan con ella.

programme.desc: Poncho es un jovencito que decide irse a vivir a la calle, pues los maltratos del esposo de su abuela son insoportables. Un día conoce a dos señoras que se dedican a la explotación de menores, obligándolos a robar.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'La Mentira Dura'
programme.desc: Una joven graba videos maltratando a la gente para subirlos a la red. La mejor amiga de la joven se preocupa al saber que subir videos le ha traído algunos problemas en el colegio.

programme.title: Carving Printing Blocks: Engraving Master <40>

programme.title: Palace in the Rain: Gyeongbokgung <29>

programme.title: The Beauty of Golden Patterns. Gold Leaf Master <21>

programme.title: Echoes of a Thousand Years: Musical Instrument Master <64>

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: A Feast of Spring Flowers <15>

programme.title: Rising with the Wind: Kite Making Master <62>

programme.title: A Bowl Made by the Sea: Tongyeong Neomul Bibimbap <35>

programme.title: The Charm of Ancestral Weaving: Rush Mats <39>

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: The Last Movie Star
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as an aging screen icon who gets lured into accepting an award at a rinky-dink film festival in Nashville, launching him on both a hilarious fish-out-of-water adventure and an unexpectedly poignant journey into his past.

programme.title: Hearts in Colombo
programme.desc: When Rick surprises Shanaya by flying to Sri Lanka for Christmas, meeting her eccentric family leads to chaos, wild antics, and culture clash. Can their relationship survive the ultimate holiday test in this heartwarming Sri Lankan rom-com?

programme.title: Best Man Dead Man
programme.desc: A bachelor party in the middle of nowhere quickly turns into a night of murder and mystery when the best man ends up with a knife in his head. Everyone is a suspect; only an eccentric private eye in town can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Young Werther
programme.desc: While on an errand to Toronto, a charming young writer named Werther meets the love of his life only to discover that the young woman is engaged. His world turns upside down in a desperate, misguided and hilarious quest to win her heart.

programme.title: Fairyland
programme.desc: Fairyland is a coming-of-age story in San Francisco's vibrant scene in the '70s and '80s. This film chronicles a father and daughter relationship as it evolves through an era of bohemian decadence to the sober and heartbreaking era of the AIDS crisis

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: Hapless family man Paul Matthews (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate the consequences of his newfound stardom.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. For Milo, it means meeting with his first love to see if their romance can reignite. Eventually, they learn that living truthfully and accepting each other is the only way to move forward.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Not content with his job as a bouncer, Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) dreams of a more rewarding job and gaining his parents' respect.

programme.title: The Expendables 2

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.desc: Having long-since abandoned his life as a lethal soldier, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) lives a solitary life near the Thai border. The missionaries have not returned, and although he is reluctant to embrace violence again, Rambo sets out to rescue the captives from the Burmese army.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge

programme.title: Den of Thieves

Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: Killers

As Balzary and his squad launch an all-out attack, father and son retreat to a high-tech bunker that has steel walls and advanced weapons.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: Inherit the Viper
programme.desc: For siblings Kip and Josie, dealing opioids isn't just their family business -- it's their only means of survival. When a deal goes fatally wrong, Kip decides he wants out for good. But his attempt to escape his family's legacy soon ignites a powder keg of violence and betrayal, endangering Kip, Josie and their younger brother.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent is called upon to guard the life of his mortal enemy, one of the world's most notorious hit men. The relentless bodyguard and manipulative assassin have been on the opposite end of the bullet for years and are thrown together for a wildly outrageous 24 hours. During their journey from England to The Hague, they encounter high-speed car chases, outlandish boat escapades and a merciless Eastern European dictator who is out for blood.

programme.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Bodyguard Michael Bryce and hitman Darius Kincaid are back for another life-threatening mission; still unlicensed and under scrutiny, Bryce is forced into action by Darius's even more volatile wife; soon, all three are in over their heads when a madman's sinister plot threatens to leave Europe in chaos.

programme.title: Long Shot

Charlotte Field is one of the most influential women in the world -- a smart, sophisticated and accomplished politician. When Fred unexpectedly runs into Charlotte, he soon realizes that she was his former babysitter and childhood crush. When Charlotte decides to make a run for the presidency, she impulsively hires Fred as her speechwriter -- much to the dismay of her trusted advisers.

programme.title: A Simple Favor

Her best friend, Emily, seems to have it all, a successful career, a loving family and a glamorous lifestyle. What Mike doesn't know is that he was trained by the CIA to be a lethal killing machine. When the agency targets him for termination, his former handler activates his latent skills, turning the mild-mannered slacker into a deadly weapon. Now, the utterly surprised Mike must use his newfound abilities to save himself and his girlfriend from getting smoked.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Fatal Liaison - The Strange Affair of Adolf and Eva
programme.desc: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler's bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: The history of armed conflict is intrinsically tied to the history of civilization and Man's quest for the basic things in life. Over the centuries those weapons ranged from bow and arrows to armor, swords and chain mail. But one technological development left them all behind - the invention of gunpowder. Since then, the advances in weaponry have been both awe-inspiring, and frightening.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: A journey into his world. The film explores the roots of Adolf Hitler and traces the story of his life from the town of his birth to his final days in a Berlin bunker.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.desc: In this episode, the complex web of alliances and partnerships forms as the conflict expands. The entry of the Soviet Union and the United States into the war drastically shifts the balance of power. We also explore the significance of Japan's imperial ambitions, culminating in the attack on Pearl Harbor, which brought the U.S. fully into the conflict.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: By 1943-1944, as the Germans are desperately struggling to hold their ground, they are increasingly hindered by the Soviet partisans, which contain many former Red Army soldiers that had been cut off behind enemy lines. The Germans responded with intensive counter-insurgency campaigns and brutal reprisals against the civilian population.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The post-war government of Germany is shown. The U.S. in Cologne puts things in order. The Potsdam Conference and Nuremberg War Crimes Trials are shown.

programme.title: Hitler and Churchill: The Eagle and the Lion
programme.desc: From 1940 to 1945, these two vastly contradictory personalities thought of nothing else but how to destroy each other. For the first time, a film tells the story of this clash of the giants from their common experience in the trenches of the First World War until the end of World War II.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: By 1943-1944, as the Germans are desperately struggling to hold their ground, they are increasingly hindered by the Soviet partisans, which contain many former Red Army soldiers that had been cut off behind enemy lines. The Germans responded with intensive counter-insurgency campaigns and brutal reprisals against the civilian population.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Six months after the fall of France, V. Molotov visited Berlin to discuss how the world was to be divided after victory. He was told Britain was defeated. But Britain wasn't beaten. Just alone.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The United Nations planned how best to secure victory and how to arrange the post war world at conference after conference. The Allies fought one war on two fronts. The Axis fought two wars. For both, 1943 would mark the beginning of the end.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: In 1944, in southern England, Allied troops are getting ready to land in Normandy. US soldier Jack Lieb is there with his amateur camera. On D-Day, John Ford shoots in colour with his camera crews. His Hollywood colleague George Stevens also lands in northern France with his team on 6 June 1944. The men document the advance and finally the liberation of Paris up close.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: The United States fought two battles here-the U.S. Marines at Iwo Jima against the Japanese, and the U.S. Navy against the typhoon. During the now-legendary events depicted in this episode, the series reaches the final throes of battle in the Pacific war against the Japanese.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: This German Field Marshall had tributes paid to him by both Winston Churchill and Adolf Hitler. He was revered by his own troops and respected by those who fought against him. A close adviser to The Fuhrer, and part of an attempt to kill him. Rommel's controversial legacy as both a hero, and a War Criminal is still debated today.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The United Nations planned how best to secure victory and how to arrange the post war world at conference after conference. The Allies fought one war on two fronts. The Axis fought two wars. For both, 1943 would mark the beginning of the end.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Threatened by numerous attacks by enemy troops in the Cam Lo area, 8,500 Marines and 3,000 ARVN troops strike along the Demilitarized Zone on July 7, 1966. The battle, Operation Hastings, lasted until August 3rd. The Marines pushed the NVA forces back across the DMZ.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Threatened by numerous attacks by enemy troops in the Cam Lo area, 8,500 Marines and 3,000 ARVN troops strike along the Demilitarized Zone on July 7, 1966. The battle, Operation Hastings, lasted until August 3rd. The Marines pushed the NVA forces back across the DMZ.

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944: A monumental Allied force assembles to liberate Europe from Nazi rule. With tension high and WWII entering its fifth year, two million soldiers stand prepared for sacrifice. In France, civilians eagerly await their deliverance, listening to Radio-London. As Allies land in Normandy, civilians, oblivious to danger, emerge to welcome them amidst combat.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: This German Field Marshall had tributes paid to him by both Winston Churchill and Adolf Hitler. He was revered by his own troops and respected by those who fought against him. A close adviser to The Fuhrer, and part of an attempt to kill him. Rommel's controversial legacy as both a hero, and a War Criminal is still debated today.

programme.title: Night Bombers
programme.desc: Rare archive colour footage of an RAF bombing raid on Berlin in the winter of 1943 - probably the most heavily defended target of them all. 440 Avro Lancaster heavy bombers and 4 de Havilland Mosquitos led the attack causing extensive damage to Berlin.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: A film about the Forward Air Controller, whose job it was to spot enemy positions and mark them for attack.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft - WWII
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircraft used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry focuses on fighters used in WWII, like the P-51 Mustang, P-38 Lockheed Lightning, F4U Corsair, Messerschmidt Bf-109, Hawker Hurricane, Mitsubishi A6M Zero, Supermarine Spitfire and more.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The strategic Marine Corps base at Khe Sanh was located a few miles from the borders of North Vietnam and Laos. Khe Sanh was heavily fortified in late '67 and designed to carry out reconnaissance attacks on the Ho Chi Minh trail and enemy supply lines from the north.

programme.title: Mother of Normandy
programme.desc: Leslie Caron narrates 'Mother of Normandy,' a documentary highlighting Simone Renaud, wife of the wartime Mayor of Ste. Mere-Eglise. For 44 years, she expressed gratitude to D-Day veterans and families by tending graves, corresponding, and organizing commemorations. Renaud became a cherished figure, leaving an enduring impact on those touched by D-Day's legacy.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Big Slim is an aviation legend. During a nail-biting engagement in the skies over Europe, Sgt Fred 'Big Slim' Richardson's tall frame was struck by thirty-six pieces of shrapnel. Stars Jim Hutton.

programme.title: First to Fight

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Our patrols in probing actions... The attack on Hill 1179... The return of Seoul refugees... and more of the ceasefire negotiations. programme.title: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after the defeat of Kaiser Wilhem the II, the German navy, The Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time through Hitler's Third Reich. programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium. Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

programme.title: WWII: Capitulation
programme.desc: May 8, 1945. While the Allied troops were parading through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War was in its final, apocalyptic hours. The weeks preceding the end of the conflict would usher in a new world. The Soviets, more powerful than ever, invaded conquered territories and terrorized survivors. The last Nazi soldiers attempted to escape their inevitable fates.

A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: The Blitz shook Britain, but the Allies struck back harder with strategic bombing. Technology advanced-radar, gun turrets, and bomb sights changed everything. Civil defenses rose. After Pearl Harbor, the US joined in, bringing more bombers, more power, and a new level of destruction to the war.

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David searches out Britain's eccentric amateur inventors and backyard boffins, who played a key role in the defeat of Hitler and created the machinery of 21st-century surveillance.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: US Army film intended to familiarize US troops with the tactics employed by the Vietcong. Consists mostly of captured VC propaganda footage.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Developed in 1938, this 'miracle pill' boosted soldiers' endurance and morale, becoming a weapon of war. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: The Reich Underground
programme.desc: Today, many of the half-built facilities have been long-forgotten. With previously unreleased film material and exclusive interviews, the fascinating and dramatic story of the Underground Reich is reconstructed when the Nazis leaders still hoped that the miracle weapons they produced would bring Germany final victory.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. At HQ he unveils a night-vision device in his Messerschmitt, letting it fly unseen in darkness. The Germans, aware of an imminent Soviet infantry assault on the bridgehead, prepare a deadly surprise for the bombers-an invisible Messer.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium. Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Before 1941 was half over, the Soviet Union was locked in struggle with Germany. Before the year was out, humanity would be hanging on the fate of Roosevelt's great union, compelled to join the struggle by what he termed 'a date which will live in infamy.'

programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: North Korea crosses the 38th Parallel and invades South Korea on June 25, 1950. The North pushes through initial defenses and captures Seoul and US and UN forces dig in at Pusan.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: One of the reasons for the success of the D-Day landings was the element of surprise, the huge invasion force, congregating along the south coast of England went undetected by German Intelligence.

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the campaign in the Solomon Islands directed at the Japanese stronghold on Bougainville. Allied troops eventually secure the beach and slowly fight their way across the island. The Japanese launch a counter-attack, but they are defeated in the Battle of Empress Augusta Bay. After brutal fighting, the island is secured.

programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: With U.S. and U.N. forces locked in the struggle to break out from Pusan , MacArthur put in place what was perhaps the most remembered aspect of the Korean War: The amphibious landing at Inchon.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: America's Greatest Generals
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Operation Dewey Canyon, from January 22 through March 18, 1969, was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. The 9th Marine Regiment reinforced by elements of the 3rd Marine Regiment swept through the A Shau Valley engaging in 56 days of combat mainly against the North Vietnamese Army.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The great rivers of the Rhineland along Germany's western border must be crossed to take the fight to the enemy's home turf. A series of interlocking ground and air operations begin in the North with Montgomery commanding a cooperative of American, British and Canadian forces. The soldiers of the Third Reich are dug in deep, however, and the going will be tough, and price of success will be high.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: American Army and Marine forces land unopposed and meet little resistance as they split Okinawa in half. Later, as armies move north and south, fighting grows more fierce. In the southern half, stiff Japanese resistance and rain bog down offensive operations. In the end, the Battle of Okinawa proves costly for both sides.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
programme.desc: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler's wilderness years in Vienna and Munich. Using rare archive film and new footage of his boyhood home we follow Hitler's descent from aspiring art student to homeless drifter living in a men's shelter in Vienna.

programme.title: 3 Days in the Life of Lt. Kravtsov
programme.desc: This story underscores the harsh realities of war and the profound impact it has on young soldiers like Lt. Kravtsov. It raises questions about sacrifice, the fragility of life, and the emotional toll of warfare. Will Lt. Kravtsov defy the odds and survive his assigned three days? The answer remains uncertain in this poignant narrative of youth and the cost of war.

Watch the rise of Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany and learn of those who attempted to stop his bid for global domination. See for yourself the preparations made by the people of Britain as war became inevitable.

programme.desc: A closer look at the men of steel, and the steel of industry that make up the heroes of The Mighty Eighth, following their roles, responsibilities, and profiling some of the gladiators of the sky. 8th Air Force bomber and fighter veterans discuss the experience of bailing out, and give witness to the courage and sacrifice of those who came home, and those who did not...

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Tensions begin to rise in Korea.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Story of the three-day attack on St. Vith and retreat of American troops when the town was lost to the Germans. Fighting by 84th infantry division in Battle of the Bulge, crossing of the Roer and Rhine, and the desperate race to the Elbe.

programme.title: Visions of War: U.S. Marines
programme.desc: Fury in the Pacific is a documentary about a pair of World War II battles in the Pacific: the Battle of Peleliu and the Battle of Angaur. It was co-produced by the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and the U.S. Marines, and directed by a series of combat cameraman. The film is noteworthy for its praise of the fighting abilities of Japanese soldiers, and its fast-paced editing.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Jungles of Death
programme.desc: The story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

Mark uncovers how Osmond, a banker for HSBC, bravely joined the Hong Kong Volunteer Defence Force and was thrown into a deadly battle to defend the island, then was shot on Christmas day and taken as a POW.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: When the Japanese navy bombs Alaska and occupies islands off its shores, the U.S. responds by air and by sea and forces them out.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The great rivers of the Rhineland along Germany's western border must be crossed to take the fight to the enemy's home turf. A series of interlocking ground and air operations begin in the North with Montgomery commanding a cooperative of American, British and Canadian forces. The soldiers of the Third Reich are dug in deep, however, and the going will be tough, and price of success will be high.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. In the New Terminal, the volunteer fighters argue, laugh, violate the commander's orders while defending the airport. programme.title: The Crusade in Europe

programme.desc: Story of the three-day attack on St. Vith and retreat of American troops when the town was lost to the Germans. Fighting by 84th infantry division in Battle of the Bulge, crossing of the Roer and Rhine, and the desperate race to the Elbe.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

programme.title: First to Fight

programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. A group of Ukrainian Army fighters heads to Donetsk airport for its defense. The name Cyborgs, Defenders of the Donetsk Airport, is given to the Ukrainian fighters for their grit, bravery and heroics.

programme.title: Broken Arrows: The Lost Bombs of the Cold War
programme.desc: The 1966 Palomares B-52 crash occurred on 17 January 1966, when a B-52G bomber and a KC-135 tanker collided. The damage and radiation still exists to this day. In 1968 a B-52 bomber near Thule Air Base in Greenland crashed onto sea ice in North Star Bay. The explosives aboard to detonated and the nuclear payload to rupture and dispersed, resulting in radioactive contamination.

programme.title: Line of Fire: Stalingrad
programme.desc: This documentary traces the battle for Stalingrad, which proved to be the turning point for the Allies on the eastern front during the Second World War. Included is expert analysis by Dr Duncan Anderson and Dr Aryk Nusbacher. The bitter, bloody and inhuman struggle for Stalingrad was the turning point of the war on the eastern front and a pivotal moment of World War Two.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days

programme.title: The Attackers

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat

programme.desc: This is the story of the rise and fall of one of the legendary forces of warfare. programme.title: Soviet Storm

programme.title: The Missing
programme.desc: When rancher and single mother of two Maggie Gilkeson (Cate Blanchett) sees her teenage daughter, Lilly (Evan Rachel Wood), kidnapped by Apache rebels, she reluctantly accepts the help of her estranged father, Samuel (Tommy Lee Jones), in tracking down the kidnappers. Along the way, the two must learn to reconcile the past and work together if they are going to have any hope of getting Lilly back before she is taken over the border and forced to become a prostitute.

programme.title: Broken Trail
programme.desc: A veteran cowboy and his nephew save five Chinese girls from prostitution while trekking from Oregon to Wyoming.

programme.title: Broken Trail
programme.desc: A veteran cowboy and his nephew save five Chinese girls from prostitution while trekking from Oregon to Wyoming.

programme.title: Westward the Women
programme.desc: There's a deficit of good, honest women in the West, and Roy Whitman (John McIntire) wants to change that. His solution is to bring a caravan of over 100 mail-order brides from Chicago to California. It will be a long, difficult and dangerous journey for the women. So Whitman hires hardened, cynical Buck Wyatt (Robert Taylor) to be their guide across the inhospitable frontier. But as disaster strikes on the trail, Buck just might discover that these women are stronger than he thinks.

programme.title: A Day of Fury
programme.desc: A town marshal (Jock Mahoney) owes his life to an aging gunfighter (Dale Robertson) and refuses to stop him until the debt is paid.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Frankie befriends an outlaw.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: While investigating a train robbery, Matt Clark learns about Johnny Ringo; Frankie gets a job doing undercover work; Matt tracks Johnny down.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Former deputies plan on robbing a gold shipment after their brother is killed.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Matt and Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to track down Doc Holliday who they suspect is involved with the Clanton gang; while there, they meet famed sheriff Wyatt Earp and become part of the gunfight at the O.K. Corral.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Frank Leslie returns from prison to marry the widow of the man he killed; the dead man's brothers plan to exact their own form of justice, even though Sheriff Hollister has ordered them to get out of town by sundown.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: While outnumbered, Hollister and Calibourne take on raiders to restore peace in Osage.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A rancher is shot by an unknown killer, and his daughter's lover is jailed.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A group of outlaws devises a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: After Lucas kills a mountain man in a barroom brawl, his father arrives in North Fork determined to take revenge on Lucas and Marshal Torrance, once he breaks his other two boys out of jail.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A dying gunslinger attracts trouble.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat bargains with outlaws to keep them from taking a widow's Medal of Honor; the thieves decide to rob Bat as well, making off with his money and cane along with the precious heirloom.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: After three gunmen on the gallows receive amnesty for their participation in the Lincoln County War, they resume their life of crime, and Bat must help the local marshal bring them to justice once again.

programme.title: Yancy Derringer
programme.desc: Yancy and Administrator Colton attempt to combat superstition when a voodoo priestess terrorizes the city.

programme.title: Yancy Derringer
programme.desc: Mei Ling gets arrested for opium smuggling after ordering firecrackers from San Francisco.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: Fugitive enchants naive young woman.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: A Yankee commander must contend with mutiny as Confederate troops attack.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: The pony express hires Josh to find the murderer of a rider who stole a diamond ring.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh tries to prevent the hanging of the prisoner he has just brought in.

programme.title: Best of the Badmen
programme.desc: After the North defeats the South, Union Maj. Jeff Clanton heads to Missouri to provide the Confederacy's Quantrill's Raiders a chance to claim allegiance to the Union, thereby clearing their wanted status. But standing in Clanton's way are the corrupt lawmen Joad and Fowler, who would rather keep the men outlaws to collect the reward on their heads. After Joad and Fowler frame Clanton for murder, he manages to escape, becoming an outlaw himself.

programme.title: Return of the Gunfighter
programme.desc: Ben Wyatt (Robert Taylor) is an aging gunfighter who has grown weary of his lifestyle. But when an old friend, Luis (Rodolfo Hoyos Jr.), asks for help defending his land, Ben can't say no. Unfortunately, he arrives too late, finding Luis and his entire family -- except daughter Anisa (Ana Martín) -- murdered. Ben is determined to get revenge against the killers, and in pursuing them reluctantly enlists the aid a younger gunfighter, Lee Sutton (Chad Everett).

programme.title: Many Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: Headstrong Mary Stuart Cherne (Eleanor Parker) is in hot pursuit of frontiersman Bushrod Gentry (Robert Taylor), and is determined to make him her husband. Naturally, Bushrod has no desire to leave the happy, wandering life of a trapper. He heads north to escape Mary's nuptial advances. But with hostile Shawnee Indians at every turn, Bushrod and Mary must set aside their differences and work together to survive the wilds of the unfamiliar territory.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: A handsome visiting attorney gets involved with a pair of strange sisters.

programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy's peaceful Alaskan retreat turns into a nightmare when their daughter unknowingly invites a dark entity through witchcraft. What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Michigan attorney Chris Gibbons and his family move into their dream house, which quickly becomes a nightmare. A bizarre combination of terrifying dreams and ghost sightings force Chris to do battle with the supernatural.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Sidney's girlfriend moves in, he and his mother, Jaime, experience disturbing events, escalating from eerie calls to physical attacks. They soon discover an ex-friend is using witchcraft to tear them apart. As Jaime becomes the target of a deadly assault, the family, fearing for their lives, seeks the help of paranormal investigators before the dark forces succeed in their sinister plan.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Candace and John St. Clair visit a haunted tunnel where slaves were buried alive, something follows them home. Their daughter has terrifying nightmares, dishes shatter, and the entity soon turns violent. Attacked and terrified, they call paranormal experts to cleanse their home-before they're forced to flee from the malevolent presence.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 2012, Amanda Morrisson and her family clean a relative's home to fund his care but uncover satanic objects. Soon, they face terrifying events-Nate sees shadows, David has nightmares, and Alliah spirals into depression. When Amanda encounters a sinister entity, they seek a demonologist, who traces the haunting to an evil necklace David took from the house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. But after returning home, Jamie finds strange scratches on his leg and experiences terrifying activity-objects flying and unseen forces attacking him. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 2012, Olivia and Jesse Barbour's daughter Marie befriends a boy named Jackson-who isn't real. At first harmless, Jackson soon frightens Marie, leaving bruises and urging her to follow him to heaven. When she's found with red marks on her neck, the family seeks help. Investigators reveal Jackson is a cruel spirit-an old man disguised as a boy to torment Marie.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: While preparing their late friend Paul's house for sale, Anita Intenzo and her son Chris encounter his spirit-along with something much darker. When a violent entity attacks Chris, Anita seeks help. A medium warns of a demon linked to a mysterious artifact Paul acquired abroad. As chaos erupts in their home, Anita and Chris must locate the artifact before the demon destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Latin jazz guitarist Eddie Benitez moves to Arizona to revive his career, but his home is haunted. Strange occurrences escalate when his son falls mysteriously ill. With no medical explanation, Eddie discovers the room was the site of a horrific suicide. Fearing the spirit is slowly killing his son, Eddie turns to his Puerto Rican roots to battle the deadly entity before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After rejecting a friend's advances, Stephanie Winters is cursed. Soon, in their new Virginia home, she and her husband experience strange noises and objects moving. When the entity violently scratches and chokes Stephanie, they seek help. A paranormal investigator suspects a demonic ritual, leading them to a demonologist and the church to battle the dark force before it destroys Stephanie.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: North Carolina natives Jamie and Aaron live a 'perfect' Southern lifestyle until a dark entity begins communicating with and terrifying their children. The family risks ridicule by neighbors and family when they call paranormal experts to the rescue.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Modern science suggests we are all connected by energy. This may explain why Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona. After moving in, nightmares bleed into reality, and she sees a shadowy spirit. A clairvoyant urges her to communicate with it, but fear holds her back. As the entity targets only her, Romie begins to question her sanity-is the house haunted, or is she cursed?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer Hoke and fiancé Jamie Jones find their dream home in Pensacola, FL, but something dark lurks within. Strange noises and shadows soon escalate to violent attacks. Jamie is pulled from bed, and the family is trapped in terror. Seeking answers, they turn to a local empath, who uncovers a history more sinister than they ever imagined.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: John Drenner Jr. unknowingly unleashes a demon after finding a satanic bible in an abandoned shack. Plagued by violent attacks and nightmares, he spirals into depression. Just as the entity threatens to claim his life, he finds hope in a young woman who helps him seek deliverance. With time running out, exorcist Bill Bean must act fast to drive out the demon before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Taylor Jones reconnects with her estranged mother, Joyce, unaware of the darkness she brings. When Taylor finds Joyce practicing black magic in her daughter's room, she cuts ties-but it may be too late. Isabelle soon has an invisible friend, then grows terrified to be alone. As the haunting escalates, a paranormal team uncovers a tragic past in the attic, trapping tormented souls forever.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Joy expects a fun girls' trip to a haunted plantation, but after returning home, a sinister spirit torments her children. When she sees its face in a trip photo, she realizes the entity is attached to her-not the plantation. As the spirit grows more aggressive, a determined paranormal investigator helps Joy uncover a terrifying past connection and fight to save her family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Amelia and Calvin Braddy move into a Tennessee apartment, unaware it was once the site of a deadly fire. Amelia senses a presence, believing the spirits of lost children haunt their home. But when the activity turns violent, they realize a darker force is at play-one targeting their family. Desperate for safety, they seek paranormal investigators before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn't believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Dennis Pongratz discovers his late father's WWII memorabilia, including a Nazi armband, eerie phenomena erupt in his home. A vengeful soldier's spirit seeks havoc, while another tries to stop it. As their home becomes a battleground between good and evil, Dennis and his wife Debbie must find a way to end the terror before it consumes them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 1983, the Fox family moves into a historic Arkansas home, but their daughter Mary quickly becomes the target of an unseen evil. An angry ghost and a demon haunt her dreams and waking life, hinting at the home's dark past. As the attacks intensify, the family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst fear-Mary is in grave danger.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activity inside her new home, she suspects spirits tied to the house's history. But after something evil attacks Tracey, she fears for the safety of her family and turns to paranormal investigators for help.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When his mother's house is haunted by a demon, Connecticut paranormal investigator Bob Baker calls in colleagues and a Bishop for help. But when they fail to cleanse the home, it's up to Bob to do the job, using experience from his own 'haunted' past.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Alicia and Scott Cain's daughter befriends spirits of two boys who died in a fire, but their presence brings terrifying consequences. When Alicia and her older daughter encounter a blood-soaked apparition, they uncover a brutal murder tied to their home. Paranormal investigators and a priest intervene, but will they be able to free the family from the grip of these vengeful spirits?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After moving into a rural Indiana home, Jennifer Patterson hears voices and smells strange scents, suspecting the deceased former owner still lingers. Hoping to coexist, she stays-until the activity turns violent after her boyfriend moves in. Fearing for their safety, the couple seeks help from paranormal experts to uncover the dark truth behind their haunting.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Carl, Keith, and Cynthia use a spirit board to contact a ghost in their home. At first, it seems harmless, but as violent activity increases, Keith senses danger. Carl, obsessed with the entity, ignores the warnings-until Cynthia is attacked. Realizing they've unleashed something sinister, the brothers call in a paranormal investigator to stop the terrifying presence before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: During renovations, Debbie Guy notices strange activity in her historic Pennsylvania home. After a guest dabbles in black magic, the disturbances turn violent. A ritual sacrifice unleashes a dark force that torments the household. A pastor's blessing fails, and paranormal investigators face their toughest case yet as they battle an evil entity that refuses to be controlled.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: Catch Me Up With Jon Leiberman
programme.desc: The news show for people who don't watch the news. Jon Leiberman (Howard Stern and America's Most Wanted) hosts this recap of the most important, compelling and craziest stories of the week.

programme.title: Three Musketeers
programme.desc: The disbanded Musketeers reunite to defeat a beautiful double agent and the scheming man she is working for.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: After the fall of Rome, its last emperor, 12-year-old Romulus Augustus, becomes a prisoner on the island of Capri. With the help of his wise teacher Ambrosinus and his legionnaire Aurelius, he escapes from Capri. He and his men journey to Britannia to find the fabled Dragon Legion, and the beginning of the Arthurian legend is born.

programme.title: Cyclops
programme.desc: A corrupt emperor (Eric Roberts) forces a soldier (Kevin Stapleton) to fight a single-eyed giant in a gladiatorial arena.

programme.title: Solomon Kane
programme.desc: A man (James Purefoy) must renounce his newly taken vows of peace to rescue a young woman (Rachel Hurd-Wood) from an evil sorcerer (Jason Flemyng).

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons, an upper-class family, are extremely wealthy -- but also estranged. In an attempt to mend their broken family ties, Aubrey and Paul Davison decide to celebrate their wedding anniversary by inviting their four children and their children's significant others to their weekend estate. The celebration gets off to a rocky start, but when crossbow-wielding assailants in animal masks suddenly attack, the Davisons must pull together or die.

programme.title: Pretty Boy
programme.desc: A masked killer named Pretty Boy takes a blind woman from her home in the Hollywood Hills and crashes a Valentine's Day party, where the bloodshed continues.

programme.title: Clown
programme.desc: A loving father (Andy Powers) becomes a savage killer while wearing a cursed clown costume that won't come off.

programme.title: Clown Fear
programme.desc: A bridal party fights to survive and escape after it becomes stranded in a city run by clowns.

programme.title: Leatherface
programme.desc: A teenage Leatherface escapes from a mental hospital with three other inmates, kidnapping a young nurse and taking her on a road trip from hell, while being pursued by a lawman out for revenge.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw 3D
programme.desc: Decades ago, residents of Newt, Texas, long suspected that the Sawyer family was responsible for the disappearances of many people. When their suspicions finally were confirmed, vigilantes torched the Sawyer compound and killed every member of the family -- or so they thought. Much later, a young woman named Heather (Alexandra Daddario) learns that she has inherited Texas property from an unknown relative, and she is unaware of horrors that await in the mansion's dank cellar.
